news_mentions.headline: AFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Colts, Jaguars, Texans, Titans
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top

news_mentions.headline: AFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bills, Dolphins, Jets, Patriots
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

material_news_signals.headline: Ravens DC: Saints QB Tyler Shough reminds me of 'a poor man's Josh Allen'
material_news_signals.description: Ravens defensive coordinator Anthony Weaver thinks highly of the quarterback he faces Sunday, Saints starter Tyler Shough.
material_news_signals.body_text: baltimore ravens defensive coordinator anthony weaver thinks highly of the quarterback he faces sunday tyler shough when asked thursday about the second year new orleans saints quarterback weaver said i like that kid we played them towards the latter half of the year when i was in miami last year and i was impressed with him then as a rookie weaver said he reminds me a little bit of like a poor man s josh allen calling any professional athlete a poor man s anything can be viewed as a negative however naming shough in the same sentence as an alien like allen is a positive at this stage weaver s comments make it clear he meant the phrase as a compliment shough has all the arm talent in the world and can run he said i don t think he gets enough credit for how good of an athlete he is so particularly as you get down to the low red zone we are constantly going to be conscious of just his ability to scramble and create those extended plays no different than our guy with eight qb lamar jackson i just think the more reps he gets the more confident he s going to get in that scheme and with the talent around him i think they have done a good job of trying to build the talent around him they have tremendous skill players i think they have upgraded their offensive line from when i saw them a year ago so sky s the limit for the kid shough threw for a career high 410 passing yards and three passing touchdowns with two interceptions and a fumble in a 31 30 week 1 overtime loss in detroit the qb was rattled early missing a host of passes and turning it over three times in the first eight possessions however down the stretch he was money picking apart detroit s defense leading five scoring drives in their last six possessions how shough handles the ravens pressure will be key in week 1 he went 11 of 19 for 206 yards under pressure all career high marks per next gen stats baltimore generated pressure on 52 9 of dropbacks in week 1 after posting the fifth lowest pressure rate among nfl defenses last season 30 1 the ravens generated pressure in an average of 2 33 seconds their quickest mark in a game in which they generated at least 15 pressures since 2020 per ngs the saints and ravens kick off from baltimore on sunday at 1 p m et

material_news_signals.headline: Reports: Bills WR DJ Moore suffers AC joint sprain in win; status up in the air for Week 3 vs. Chargers
material_news_signals.description: DJ Moore’s second game with the Bills ended before halftime. Now, his Week 3 availability is in jeopardy.
material_news_signals.body_text: dj moore s second game with the buffalo bills ended before halftime moore came down hard in the end zone trying to catch a josh allen pass during buffalo s 41 31 win over the detroit lions on thursday night and was ruled out with a shoulder injury head coach joe brady had no update on moore s injury following the game moore is believed to have suffered an ac joint sprain nfl network insider ian rapoport reported friday morning per sources espn s adam schefter added that while doctors don t consider the injury serious his status is up in the air for week 3 versus the los angeles chargers with buffalo rolling and leading 21 7 allen threw into the end zone for moore on second and 3 from the 6 yard line moore attempted to haul in a low pass smashed his shoulder onto the grass rolled to his back and grabbed around the left side of his collarbone moore walked off under his own power to the locker room for x rays it was moore s first target of the game though it wasn t recorded as one as the bills were flagged for offensive holding on the play he did have a carry for a loss of a yard earlier in the game moore acquired in an offseason trade from the chicago bears had five receptions for 100 yards and a touchdown in week 1 against the houston texans the long sought no 1 wr for the bills moore s health will now be a prevailing concern for the squad heading into the week 3 matchup with the chargers

news_mentions.headline: Vikings QB Kyler Murray (concussion) out Sunday vs. Bears; Carson Wentz to start
news_mentions.description: The Vikings will be without their QB1 on Sunday against the Bears. Kyler Murray will miss the divisional matchup due to his concussion suffered in Week 1, said head coach Kevin O'Connell, who added Carson Wentz will get the start.
news_mentions.body_text: the vikings will take the field sunday without their starting quarterback kyler murray concussion will not play in minnesota s week 2 contest in chicago the quarterback was limited in practice all week and was officially ruled out friday when the team released its injury report carson wentz will get the start instead with j j mccarthy as his backup murray suffered a concussion early in minnesota s week 1 win over green bay during a short scramble which ended with murray sliding to the ground and sustaining a late hit from packers safety javon bullard murray exited the game for further evaluation and was determined to have suffered a concussion placing him in concussion protocol for the week the veteran backup wentz replaced murray and completed 12 of 19 passes for 133 yards and three touchdowns in the comeback victory murray s absence forces the vikings back into familiar territory minnesota spent much of the 2025 season cycling through quarterbacks due to injuries to mccarthy and wentz eventually turning to third stringer max brosmer out of necessity late in the season the instability prompted the vikings to quickly add murray when he became available as a free agent in march but after one week they re once again relying on a backup wentz will fill in for murray again on sunday against a bears team that scored 59 points in their week 1 win over carolina with both teams sitting atop the nfc north standings entering week 2 wentz will aim to keep pace with ben johnson s explosive bears offense while minnesota hopes murray can return in time for week 3 minnesota and chicago kick off sunday from soldier field at 1 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Falcons QB Cooper Rush to start vs. Panthers with Michael Penix Jr. ruled out again
news_mentions.description: Michael Penix Jr. still isn’t ready to make his 2026 debut for the Atlanta Falcons. Cooper Rush will start at quarterback in Sunday's Week 2 game against the Carolina Panthers.
news_mentions.body_text: michael penix still isn t ready to make his 2026 debut for the atlanta falcons cooper rush will start at quarterback in sunday s week 2 game against the carolina panthers coach kevin stefanski announced friday rush took the starting reps in friday s practice indicating he would make his second start of the season penix was officially ruled out for sunday s game the third year qb took strides forward this week including being a full participant in practice all three days but isn t quite ready to start as he continues to rehab last season s acl tear the falcons have been cautious with the former first rounder as he recovers from a third acl tear the first two coming in college tua tagovailoa appeared to be in line to open the season as the starter but suffered an oblique injury in practice before week 1 the more time he remains on the shelf coupled with poor preseason play the harder it is to see him getting a legit shot in atl tagovailoa is officially doubtful to play but stefanski said friday that jack strand will be rush s backup against carolina despite a back issue that popped up late last week rush started sunday s game against the pittsburgh steelers the 32 year old backup struggled mightily completing 12 of 22 attempts for 143 yards with a touchdown and two interceptions including a game sealing pick six rush couldn t stretch the field with just six pass attempts two completions going further than 9 air yards six of his 12 completions were behind the line of scrimmage he did not complete a pass when pressured per next gen stats atlanta hopes last week s struggles were a byproduct of rush playing on short notice and dealing with a tweaked back if it s more of the same the falcons will start the season 0 2 either way expect a lot of bijan robinson again in week 2 against the panthers who gave up 100 plus rushing yards to two different chicago running backs last week

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 2 picks: Upset and score predictions, matchup breakdowns for every game
news_mentions.description: Can the Texans and Broncos bounce back from uncharacteristic performances in Week 1? Will the Bears and Ravens continue to score points in bunches? Who's on upset watch? Check out the Week 2 game picks!
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 2 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 p m et on thursday sept 17 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday sept 20 why dan picked the panthers week 1 offered a stark reminder about the current state of play if you can t score points in bunches wins are going to be hard to come by in 2026 the panthers demonstrated the ability to put the ball in the paint albeit in a 59 37 season opening loss to the bears the falcons could muster just 13 points with third string qb cooper rush at the helm against pittsburgh and they enter week 2 with no clearly defined answer as to which qb gives them the best chance to win undrafted rookie jack strand out of minnesota state moorhead was the only falcons qb not listed on wednesday s injury report although michael penix knee and rush back practiced while tua tagovailoa oblique did not head coach kevin stefanski has yet to announce a starter as of this writing editor s update cooper rush will start his second straight game for the falcons kevin stefanski announced on friday both teams have their own crises to figure out but as awful as carolina s defense looked against the bears and yes ejiro evero s crew was inept i think the bigger disaster is atlanta s quarterback situation if bryce young takes a step backward after a strong showing last week something that certainly can t be ruled out maybe the door opens for the falcons it s a shame to be wasting a group that includes bijan robinson drake london and kyle pitts but until i see potency from the falcons offense i m not going to like their chances most days why brooke picked the ravens well i ll be this is a ravens offense i can get behind lamar jackson derrick henry and zay flowers absolutely cooked in the opener to the tune of 506 total yards and 41 points one of the more eye popping stats from last week per ngs 110 of henry s 144 rush yards came before contact the third highest single game total of his career and he was hit at the line of scrimmage on just 8 3 percent of his carries the lowest rate of his ravens tenure i m all in on this star studded offense early in 2026 despite the lengthy midweek injury report the saints could very well be chasing points again on the road and tyler shough looks built to scratch and claw until the very end however you can t always count on a late surge in this league not against the ravens stout pass defense and not against a henry led baltimore run game that is sure to drain the clock why dan picked the bears we have our very early favorite for the coaching matchup of the year here with the bears offensive mastermind ben johnson facing off against vikings defensive genius brian flores who will emerge victorious in the battle between two men who seem to try to redefine the word aggressive on a weekly basis johnson has already stated he wants the bears to break the single season scoring record and he apparently meant it given that his team dropped 59 points on the panthers last week as for flores minnesota blitzed 78 3 percent of the time against the packers no other team had a blitz rate higher than 52 percent in week 1 for what it s worth caleb williams completed 9 of 14 passes for 142 yards and two touchdowns against the blitz last week he did not fare as well when flores sent a blitz at him 67 percent of the time in their last meeting a 19 17 bears win in week 11 of last season sunday s contest will give us a much better gauge on whether williams really has entered the elite tier i m on record as a believer why bobby picked the bengals let s start this off with a declaration that could immediately backfire cincinnati s defense will be the difference in this game it s only a one week sample size but the bengals appear to have constructed a unit that can properly complement joe burrow s offense cincy s defense actually scored the team s opening points of the 2026 season on a scoop and score by linebacker demetrius knight in the first quarter against the buccaneers the bengals went on to hold tampa bay under 200 passing yards 193 and 100 rushing yards 89 something they only accomplished once last year and that took them until week 17 if they can replicate something close to that performance on sunday their prospects versus the texans are promising houston s defense although stacked with talent at every level also notably looks vulnerable to a passer of burrow s caliber after giving up 36 points to josh allen and the bills the texans are sure to recalibrate defensively but cincinnati s offense also has room to grow burrow didn t play lights out against the bucs he threw for 254 yards and a touchdown but also tossed a pick six and ja 39 marr chase two catches for 12 yards was practically invisible yet the bengals 33 points still exceeded their last three openers combined 30 points if cincy has finally figured out how to bypass its typical early season woes look out why gennaro picked the patriots is new england doomed to suffer the infamous super bowl hangover last week s instant sb rematch was certainly headache inducing for the franchise in the first half the patriots struggled to sustain drives against a fierce seahawks defense hell bent on holding its ground after sam darnold s opening drive injury in the third quarter the pats lost a j brown to injured reserve and in the fourth quarter drake maye lost the game with three interceptions to his credit last season s mvp runner up immediately owned the meltdown saying his impatience cost the team a win patience is absolutely a virtue against this week s opponent while the steelers now have an offensive minded head coach in mike mccarthy they still feature the same wildly opportunistic defense with t j watt s pick six powering pittsburgh past atlanta to state the obvious maye must take care of the football a directive mike vrabel s undoubtedly hammering home in the 10 days between last week s road collapse and this sunday s home opener with a more composed effort from the 24 year old quarterback the reigning afc champs should be able to take care of business against a steelers squad that looks like it will continue to live in the bottom half of the league offensively why jeremy picked the jets the packers have lost six straight games their longest such streak since the george h w bush administration the jets enter a home game undefeated in season for the first time since 2018 pigs are flying but what about the pigskin on sunday in east rutherford this one is difficult to assess because green bay and new york s week 1 outcomes were so out of character both the packers and jets held leads for more than three quarters of play but green bay collapsed in unfathomable fashion against minnesota while new york ran over an overmatched titans team both results may well have been flukes or not the jets pass rush sent cam ward running for his life in week 1 and given how brian flores defense terrorized jordan love one can expect similar pressure success from new york at metlife stadium however love is a more composed qb with more established weapons going up against an untested gang green defense again unpredictable new york played from ahead all day long against tennessee running the ball down the titans throats but if the jets fall behind by two scores to the packers can they ride 14 personnel to a comeback to be fair green bay has held a two score lead in four of its last six games all losses so maybe a true toss up in the meadowlands goes to the team in green er white who should benefit from a fan base that hasn t been this hyped up for a week 2 home game since the rex ryan era why brooke picked the buccaneers the doctor ordered a nice prescription for the buccaneers after last week s turnover fest in the form of the browns who were abysmal in the opener i fully expect to see a more poised baker mayfield in his return to raymond james stadium and against the team that drafted him and sent him packing after four seasons cleveland trotting qb deshaun watson back out there doesn t exactly inspire confidence when you consider he ll face a todd bowles defense that blitzed at the third highest rate 48 6 percent in week 1 and that watson completed 2 of 5 passes for 20 yards and an int with two sacks taken when blitzed in week 1 it s a recipe for another frustrating day for browns fans bucs by multiple touchdowns why jeremy picked the eagles a week after green clad yankees stormed broadway took over the bars and stadium and cheered on a dominant win for the away side titans fans can expect the same again trade out geno smith and the jets for jalen hurts and the eagles and robert saleh s titans have another rout on their hands if they re not careful no quarterbacks have been better on the road in september than hurts and patrick mahomes 800 on their careers and the former is coming off a well balanced season debut losing landon dickerson the week before jeffery simmons is on the docket isn t a plus but replacing the banged up guard may be addition by subtraction the even greater mismatch could come on the other side of the ball where the worst offense in the league since 2025 is going up against a vic fangio led defense that has paced the nfl in opponent passer rating in the same span in their last four meetings fangio s eagles have held titans oc brian daboll s offenses to a combined 70 points with a 34 point giants outburst last year the lone exception to the dc s dominance in the battle wan dale robinson and a mobile quarterback jaxson dart played key roles in flipping that token tie toward daboll will ward and co deliver a similar result the odds are not in favor of nash vegas why gennaro picked the broncos the jaguars rollicked to a 24 point victory in week 1 while the broncos lost by 21 so what gives with this prediction well jacksonville got to open its season at home against lowly cleveland while denver had to travel to kansas city to face the division rival chiefs in prime time now don t get me wrong sean payton s squad stunk up arrowhead stadium this past monday night with kenneth walker running circles around the broncos vaunted defense while davis webb laid an egg in his debut as denver s offensive play caller but i view this battle tested team which boasts enviable continuity from last year s 14 3 roster as a major bounce back candidate in its home opener payton openly expressed his displeasure with webb s pass happy approach in k c so it s safe to expect a more balanced offense in week 2 that said the jaguars yielded the fewest rushing yards in the league last season so i don t see anthony campanile s defense getting completely gashed on the ground with well rounded teams on both sides this feels like a game that could come down to a few key plays that s where jaylen waddle enters the picture you re forgiven if you forgot about denver s blockbuster trade addition after all he caught one pass for 2 yards in his broncos debut but the explosive wideout was acquired to put denver s loaded roster over the top against fellow contenders i think he does just that on sunday why brooke picked the chargers the big concern coming into this contest is the health of chargers wr ladd mcconkey who s day to day with a ribs injury he sustained in the third quarter of last week s surprising loss to the cardinals it was alarming to see how little justin herbert had to work with after mcconkey s exit who steps up is anybody s guess quentin johnston tre harris marquez valdes scantling who reportedly is signing to the practice squad it s on mike mcdaniel to game plan a short term fix though maybe just handing the rock to omarion hampton is the answer history is on herbert s side as he s defeated this division foe more than any other franchise in his career not to mention jim harbaugh has never started 0 2 in his nfl or fbs coaching career that s all the convincing i need i liked what i saw from the raiders last week but it s tough to really assess their home victory over a rebuilding miami team that sorely lacks talent i do think the 2026 version of this offense is in good position to compete with a steady kirk cousins and ascending ashton jeanty leading the way but i m not putting all my eggs in this basket quite yet getting brock bowers knee back could tip the scales as could any number of big plays from either side why brooke picked the seahawks drew lock played adequately last week in relief of sam darnold glute throwing for nearly 200 yards and a touchdown can he deliver for a second straight game in what will be his first start since week 18 of the 2024 season lock and co likely will have to score more than 13 points to get it done look for them to continue leaning into the play action pass which oc brian fleury called on 10 of their 27 pass attempts 37 last week the fourth highest rate in the league in week 1 per next gen stats and while the hawks had only one explosive play 20 plus yard completion on those 10 play action dropbacks the cardinals defense didn t exactly thrive in that area in week 1 either arizona gave up six catches on seven such attempts and 10 5 air yards per target ninth highest in the nfl against the chargers this is where seattle s offense could find more success with lock under center as impressed as i was with mike lafleur s balanced and efficient offense last time out i m unsure whether jacoby brissett jeremiyah love and friends can move the ball as easily against mike macdonald s vaunted defense specifically the secondary that unit which smacked the pats in the mouth again sets the tone and can help seattle tread water until darnold returns why jeremy picked the cowboys the runts of the nfc east through one week open up the at t stadium slate with a lot at stake considered by many as division favorites dallas comes into sunday looking for its third offensive possession in as many quarters it s not a good sign that the cowboys defense couldn t get off the field in prime time after an offseason of hyping up christian parker but that s not the only unit with a first time coordinator who didn t have a perfect week 1 david blough s commanders offense couldn t handle philly s pressure last sunday allowing an nfl high 50 percent pressure rate on jayden daniels and so a stoppable force meets a moveable object in arlington on the other side of the ball the explosives should come for dallas after its week 1 dud nearly shut out by the giants in that realm last sunday night the cowboys get a break but don t bend washington defense that allowed just 10 first downs but also big play after big play to the eagles four plays of at least 30 yards the dam will break eventually for big d and the cowboys will avoid their first 0 2 start in 16 years why bobby picked the 49ers it turns out that a team with 182 6 million in dead cap two rookie wide receivers starting and a dearth of experience in the secondary is going to take some time to figure things out who knew apparently everyone involved in nfl com s game picks except me the dolphins were unable to keep up in their week 1 game against the raiders and the task to do so in week 2 will be far more difficult against a 49ers squad that embarrassed the rams down under miami is thoroughly outmatched by san francisco on a position by position basis considering kirk cousins was able to toss three touchdown passes against the fins while operating almost exclusively through short area throws brock purdy at this point a far more dynamic passer could have a huge day he showed great early chemistry with mike evans picked right back up with deebo samuel and should benefit from george kittle having a game under his belt post achilles injury christian mccaffrey looks to have a little bit more pep in his step running for 6 8 yards per carry in the season opener despite dealing with cramps plus nick bosa s return and the fred warner dre greenlaw reunion has already had a noticeable effect on san francisco s defense which isn t good news for malik willis in what will still only be his eighth career start this one is likely to be all 49ers why dan picked the chiefs the vibes could not be more different for these teams coming out of week 1 the chiefs demolished the division rival broncos making it clear patrick mahomes return from injury is not a nostalgia act then there are the colts who were smacked around at home by the ravens 41 23 i know it s early in the season but it s already starting to feel like desperate times for shane steichen s team indianapolis has lost eight consecutive games dating back to week 12 of last season the longest active losing streak in the nfl lou anarumo s defense was gashed for 202 rushing yards and four rushing tds by baltimore i m not sure a week is enough time for him to find a way to slow down a suddenly super charged kansas city ground game led by marquee offseason addition kenneth walker now the colts have a strong rushing attack of their own jonathan taylor ran for nearly 100 yards and two tds last week but it wasn t nearly enough the chiefs appear to be the much better equipped squad when it comes to keeping the opposition s strength in check monday sept 21 why bobby picked the rams what a difference a week makes the rams were rolling into the season as super bowl favorites thanks to one of the splashiest offseasons in recent memory having rebuilt their secondary traded for reigning defensive player of the year myles garrett and enticed the great aaron donald out of retirement then came their season opener against the rival 49ers in australia an utterly catastrophic debut for los angeles super team to make matters worse garrett subsequently underwent knee surgery and is now on injured reserve without a timeline to return the question is whether the rams can pick up the pieces against the giants it s a task that appears a bit more difficult than initially expected both because sean mcvay s club has a ton to correct and because big blue was one of the surprises of week 1 scoring a decisive victory over the cowboys to begin the john harbaugh era new york s sunday night destruction of dallas continued jaxson dart s trend of showing up in prime time he boasts the highest passer rating 114 5 of any quarterback with at least three prime time starts per nfl research all of that leads me to believe the giants will make it close rather than win though i trust matthew stafford to rebound and los angeles has enough stars to survive garrett s absence this is also a sneaky important game for the rams they cannot afford to fall to 0 2 with their next three games coming against the broncos eagles and bills thursday s game why gennaro picked the bills there will be points i know that because the good folks at nfl research tell me detroit 29 7 ppg and buffalo 28 8 ppg boast the two highest scoring offenses in the league over everyone s past 50 regular season games furthermore it doesn t take a doctorate in statistics to see that these two defenses have issues the lions are highly suspect in the back end while the bills remain questionable up front so yes expect buffalo qb josh allen and detroit rb jahmyr gibbs to fill the fantasy coffers once again the last time these two teams met in december of 2024 they racked up 1 080 yards of offense in a scorefest the bills took 48 42 buffalo actually led that entire game though with detroit falling beyond by multiple touchdowns in each quarter before continually closing the gap to some degree i anticipate a similar game script on thursday night dan campbell s crew might aim to slow down the pace by pounding the rock but the lions are now down three starters on the offensive line add in the fact that the bills are christening their new 2 2 billion stadium and i ll ride with the home team visit responsibleplay org to learn more about responsible betting

news_mentions.headline: Bengals' Joe Burrow (back) full participant at practice, set to start Sunday vs. Texans
news_mentions.description: Joe Burrow, hampered by back tightness throughout the practice week, has no Week 2 injury designation and is good to go for Sunday’s matchup with the Texans.
news_mentions.body_text: the cincinnati bengals and their fan base can collectively loosen up joe burrow hampered by back tightness throughout the practice week was a full participant in friday s practice and is good to go for sunday s matchup with the houston texans coach zac taylor told reporters the quarterback was officially listed as questionable on cincinnati s final injury report burrow drew limited designations in practice on wednesday and thursday but maintained he would play in sunday s marquee matchup that will indeed be the case the three time pro bowler missed nine games in 2025 and seven in 2023 due to injuries so the queen city is on high alert anytime burrow has injury concerns the franchise quarterback is good to go this time around though burrow was 25 of 35 for 254 yards a touchdown and an interception in cincinnati s 33 27 season opening win over the tampa bay buccaneers burrow and the bengals 1 0 kick off on the road against the texans 0 1 at 1 p m et on sunday

news_mentions.headline: Ravens DC: Saints QB Tyler Shough reminds me of 'a poor man's Josh Allen'
news_mentions.description: Ravens defensive coordinator Anthony Weaver thinks highly of the quarterback he faces Sunday, Saints starter Tyler Shough.
news_mentions.body_text: baltimore ravens defensive coordinator anthony weaver thinks highly of the quarterback he faces sunday tyler shough when asked thursday about the second year new orleans saints quarterback weaver said i like that kid we played them towards the latter half of the year when i was in miami last year and i was impressed with him then as a rookie weaver said he reminds me a little bit of like a poor man s josh allen calling any professional athlete a poor man s anything can be viewed as a negative however naming shough in the same sentence as an alien like allen is a positive at this stage weaver s comments make it clear he meant the phrase as a compliment shough has all the arm talent in the world and can run he said i don t think he gets enough credit for how good of an athlete he is so particularly as you get down to the low red zone we are constantly going to be conscious of just his ability to scramble and create those extended plays no different than our guy with eight qb lamar jackson i just think the more reps he gets the more confident he s going to get in that scheme and with the talent around him i think they have done a good job of trying to build the talent around him they have tremendous skill players i think they have upgraded their offensive line from when i saw them a year ago so sky s the limit for the kid shough threw for a career high 410 passing yards and three passing touchdowns with two interceptions and a fumble in a 31 30 week 1 overtime loss in detroit the qb was rattled early missing a host of passes and turning it over three times in the first eight possessions however down the stretch he was money picking apart detroit s defense leading five scoring drives in their last six possessions how shough handles the ravens pressure will be key in week 1 he went 11 of 19 for 206 yards under pressure all career high marks per next gen stats baltimore generated pressure on 52 9 of dropbacks in week 1 after posting the fifth lowest pressure rate among nfl defenses last season 30 1 the ravens generated pressure in an average of 2 33 seconds their quickest mark in a game in which they generated at least 15 pressures since 2020 per ngs the saints and ravens kick off from baltimore on sunday at 1 p m et

news_mentions.headline: 'Dash Bros': George Kittle suggests nickname for himself, Kyle Juszczyk, inspired by pre-snap motion
news_mentions.description: San Francisco tight end George Kittle suggested a nickname for himself and fullback Kyle Juszczyk in their effort to improve the rushing attack for Christian McCaffrey and Kaelon Black.
news_mentions.body_text: san francisco 49ers tight end george kittle suggested a nickname for himself and fullback kyle juszczyk in their effort to improve the rushing attack for christian mccaffrey and kaelon black it s called dash bros kittle said thursday via the sacramento bee the nickname a slight play on the 2020 49ers nickname yac bros is a recognition to the pre snap dash motion that the niners employed with great aplomb in the week 1 win over the los angeles rams the specific motion involves kittle or juszczyk moving into the backfield from the line of scrimmage before changing his angle or direction right before the snap the motion makes life difficult for defenders they re not my favorite but they re very effective kittle said so i just put my pride aside and just do them i just don t like cutting and running that much i like lining up and hitting people in the face that s kind of what i do the 49ers pre snap motioned the rams to death in week 1 using motions of all varieties on 22 of their 24 designed runs per next gen stats averaging 6 1 yards per carry on those plays in week 2 the dash bros will face a dolphins defense that held the las vegas raiders to 4 1 yards per carry on designed runs in week 1 below the league average of 4 4 yards per carry that number dropped to 3 8 yards per carry when the raiders used motion pre snap the dolphins allowed a 42 2 rushing success rate in week 1 while the 49ers offense posted the league s highest rushing success rate on designed runs 52 0 miami and san francisco kick off from levi s stadium on sunday at 4 25 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Josh Allen opens Bills' new stadium with 5 TDs in dominant win over Lions
news_mentions.description: The Buffalo Bills got off to a 21-0 first half lead and never looked back in their first game at the new Highmark Stadium.
news_mentions.body_text: josh allen and the buffalo bills opened the new highmark stadium with a bang the quarterback accounted for five touchdowns three passing and two rushing as the bills romped over the detroit lions 41 31 in a game that wasn t as close as the score indicated allen noted he was emotional before kickoff as the u s and canadian national anthems played i caught myself taking it all in and understanding how cool what i get to do my job is the coolest in the world allen said thursday night via the associated press it s everything i ever wanted to be the quarterback of an nfl franchise i m just very fortunate to have ended up in buffalo the bills won the coin toss and elected to receive the ball from that moment on it was a stampede allen drove the bills down the field for a score on the opening drive he scored the first touchdown in the new highmark stadium with a 1 yard touchdown run in the first quarter the first touchdown in the old venue then known as rich stadium was scored by jerome barkum of the jets on a 34 yard pass from al woodall per nfl research the last quarterback to score the first touchdown in a new primary home stadium with a rushing touchdown was kordell stewart who opened heinz field in 2001 with an 8 yard rushing touchdown allen was electric completing 20 of his 31 pass attempts for 248 yards and three touchdowns he added 14 rushes for 69 yards and two more rushing scores it marked the fourth game of his career with three or more passing touchdowns and two or more rushing touchdowns stewart who had two in 1997 is the only other player in nfl history to tally multiple such games anytime the ball s in his hands good things happen and yeah love that guy bills coach joe brady said i wanted us to take the ball in this environment and set the tone that was the start that we needed allen dominated whatever detroit threw at him particularly the lions pressure packages detroit blitzed allen on 55 3 of his dropbacks the third highest blitz rate he has faced in a game in the last five seasons and the highest rate by the lions under dc kelvin sheppard the qb completed 12 of 17 attempts for 137 yards and two touchdowns while adding two scramble runs for 10 yards and a touchdown against those blitzes the bills proved an offensive force in every facet the ground game pounded out 203 rushing yards including 135 and a score from james cook and the pass attack put up 248 yards buffalo totaled 446 yards and 34 first downs going 9 of 12 on third downs outside of allen getting sacked twice there were few negative plays to speak of receiver josh palmer scoffed at a question about what makes the bills offense most dangerous after what they ve shown the first two weeks most dangerous i think every position is dangerous he said via tyler dunne of go long we have a dangerous running back room we have a dangerous tight end room we have a dangerous wide receiver room we have an absolutely dangerous quarterback with a dangerous o line so don t ask about dangerous sure the bills put up their trove of points against a lions defense that has looked woeful through two weeks but they also diced up a texans defense last week that is expected to be among the best in the nfl we wondered what the offense would look like with the restrictor plate off under brady turns out it s a supercharged racecar on the autobahn

news_mentions.headline: Reports: Bills WR DJ Moore suffers AC joint sprain in win; status up in the air for Week 3 vs. Chargers
news_mentions.description: DJ Moore’s second game with the Bills ended before halftime. Now, his Week 3 availability is in jeopardy.
news_mentions.body_text: dj moore s second game with the buffalo bills ended before halftime moore came down hard in the end zone trying to catch a josh allen pass during buffalo s 41 31 win over the detroit lions on thursday night and was ruled out with a shoulder injury head coach joe brady had no update on moore s injury following the game moore is believed to have suffered an ac joint sprain nfl network insider ian rapoport reported friday morning per sources espn s adam schefter added that while doctors don t consider the injury serious his status is up in the air for week 3 versus the los angeles chargers with buffalo rolling and leading 21 7 allen threw into the end zone for moore on second and 3 from the 6 yard line moore attempted to haul in a low pass smashed his shoulder onto the grass rolled to his back and grabbed around the left side of his collarbone moore walked off under his own power to the locker room for x rays it was moore s first target of the game though it wasn t recorded as one as the bills were flagged for offensive holding on the play he did have a carry for a loss of a yard earlier in the game moore acquired in an offseason trade from the chicago bears had five receptions for 100 yards and a touchdown in week 1 against the houston texans the long sought no 1 wr for the bills moore s health will now be a prevailing concern for the squad heading into the week 3 matchup with the chargers

news_mentions.headline: Bucs assistant on Baker Mayfield's past with Browns: 'They had the guy and they gave him up'
news_mentions.description: Baker Mayfield and the Buccaneers face the Cleveland Browns on Sunday, marking the second time Mayfield will face his former team since he was traded in 2022.
news_mentions.body_text: for the second time in his post cleveland career baker mayfield will face the browns this weekend this instance won t include a commemorative t shirt it will however include the only quarterback directly connected to mayfield s 2022 departure from cleveland deshaun watson sunday s contest in tampa fla will be the first opportunity for mayfield to face a watson led browns team since cleveland s pursuit of watson prompted mayfield to request and receive a trade to carolina in 2022 the outcome wasn t a simple swapping of homes and instant success for mayfield but with the benefit of five years worth of hindsight it s now clear who was the better option ken zampese current buccaneers senior offensive assistant and pass game coordinator spent time with mayfield in cleveland in 2018 and wasn t afraid to call it as he sees it prior to sunday s contest they had the guy zampese who was the browns quarterbacks coach in 2018 told espn they had the guy and they gave him up zampese s summary is accurate under coach kevin stefanski mayfield led the browns to their most successful stretch of play from 2018 2021 which included a playoff berth and the team s first postseason triumph since 1994 the high scoring wild card win over the steelers saw mayfield throw for 263 yards and three touchdowns powering a 48 37 win over the rival pittsburgh steelers in the steel city it s the high point of mayfield s tenure it s also the best memory for browns fans in the 21st century with any experience there s ups and downs good and bad mayfield said also via espn ultimately you remember the good more so than the bad the first time having a playoff win since 94 there and going on the road and doing it in pittsburgh so it s a lot of good memories there a lot of teammates that are friends for life the 2021 season wasn t as wonderful with expectations of building on their success mayfield and co arrived to more pressure in the ensuing season and when mayfield sustained a shoulder injury that likely should have sidelined him he s since admitted he shouldn t have continued playing he stubbornly stayed on the field for his team his performance suffered and after the browns missed the playoffs with an 8 9 finish cleveland s front office began to have a wandering eye their target watson who led the nfl in passing in 2020 but hadn t played football in 2021 after a trade request from houston and had been accused by more than 20 women of sexual misconduct during massage sessions once mayfield learned of cleveland s pursuit of watson he requested a trade mayfield landed in carolina where he began the 2022 season as the panthers starter with a week 1 game against cleveland jacoby brissett started in place of watson who was suspended for the first 11 games of that season and led the browns to a last second win over carolina and months later mayfield was released and landed with the los angeles rams where his career turnaround began those in cleveland still rue the day the browns began to pursue watson it s also fair to believe the mayfield stefanski partnership may have been doomed there were clues in the moment that the two were at odds which still hasn t been mended according to mayfield and as browns legend and former mayfield teammate joel bitonio explained it this week there likely wasn t enough to salvage between mayfield and the organization in 2022 you know we have this magical run and baker looks like the future of the team bitonio said during an appearance on espn cleveland 2021 we all know he s hurt right all the guys in the locker room everybody knows he s playing through this shoulder injury and things like that i told the team multiple times that i can play and baker has that same mindset and then behind the scenes you don t know what happens right as a player you only see so much i had nothing but respect for baker like i went to war with that guy he took us to the playoffs that thursday night win against the jets is still one of my fondest memories when he came into that game we won that game a lot of my happiest memories are with baker at quarterback i don t know what happened i still don t know what happened between him the ownership a b general manager andrew berry stefanski obviously it was unfixable mayfield meanwhile has moved on to greater success in tampa bay where he s won two nfc south titles and a playoff game with the buccaneers and where he recently signed his second lucrative extension and has made a home he s carrying all of us zampese said he just got rewarded for the job he s done and we all have great confidence in him doing an even better job as we move forward and i know he does too mayfield will receive his second opportunity to exact revenge on his former team sunday browns fans will do their best to cover their eyes
