news_mentions.headline: Bucs assistant on Baker Mayfield's past with Browns: 'They had the guy and they gave him up'
news_mentions.description: Baker Mayfield and the Buccaneers face the Cleveland Browns on Sunday, marking the second time Mayfield will face his former team since he was traded in 2022.
news_mentions.body_text: for the second time in his post cleveland career baker mayfield will face the browns this weekend this instance won t include a commemorative t shirt it will however include the only quarterback directly connected to mayfield s 2022 departure from cleveland deshaun watson sunday s contest in tampa fla will be the first opportunity for mayfield to face a watson led browns team since cleveland s pursuit of watson prompted mayfield to request and receive a trade to carolina in 2022 the outcome wasn t a simple swapping of homes and instant success for mayfield but with the benefit of five years worth of hindsight it s now clear who was the better option ken zampese current buccaneers senior offensive assistant and pass game coordinator spent time with mayfield in cleveland in 2018 and wasn t afraid to call it as he sees it prior to sunday s contest they had the guy zampese who was the browns quarterbacks coach in 2018 told espn they had the guy and they gave him up zampese s summary is accurate under coach kevin stefanski mayfield led the browns to their most successful stretch of play from 2018 2021 which included a playoff berth and the team s first postseason triumph since 1994 the high scoring wild card win over the steelers saw mayfield throw for 263 yards and three touchdowns powering a 48 37 win over the rival pittsburgh steelers in the steel city it s the high point of mayfield s tenure it s also the best memory for browns fans in the 21st century with any experience there s ups and downs good and bad mayfield said also via espn ultimately you remember the good more so than the bad the first time having a playoff win since 94 there and going on the road and doing it in pittsburgh so it s a lot of good memories there a lot of teammates that are friends for life the 2021 season wasn t as wonderful with expectations of building on their success mayfield and co arrived to more pressure in the ensuing season and when mayfield sustained a shoulder injury that likely should have sidelined him he s since admitted he shouldn t have continued playing he stubbornly stayed on the field for his team his performance suffered and after the browns missed the playoffs with an 8 9 finish cleveland s front office began to have a wandering eye their target watson who led the nfl in passing in 2020 but hadn t played football in 2021 after a trade request from houston and had been accused by more than 20 women of sexual misconduct during massage sessions once mayfield learned of cleveland s pursuit of watson he requested a trade mayfield landed in carolina where he began the 2022 season as the panthers starter with a week 1 game against cleveland jacoby brissett started in place of watson who was suspended for the first 11 games of that season and led the browns to a last second win over carolina and months later mayfield was released and landed with the los angeles rams where his career turnaround began those in cleveland still rue the day the browns began to pursue watson it s also fair to believe the mayfield stefanski partnership may have been doomed there were clues in the moment that the two were at odds which still hasn t been mended according to mayfield and as browns legend and former mayfield teammate joel bitonio explained it this week there likely wasn t enough to salvage between mayfield and the organization in 2022 you know we have this magical run and baker looks like the future of the team bitonio said during an appearance on espn cleveland 2021 we all know he s hurt right all the guys in the locker room everybody knows he s playing through this shoulder injury and things like that i told the team multiple times that i can play and baker has that same mindset and then behind the scenes you don t know what happens right as a player you only see so much i had nothing but respect for baker like i went to war with that guy he took us to the playoffs that thursday night win against the jets is still one of my fondest memories when he came into that game we won that game a lot of my happiest memories are with baker at quarterback i don t know what happened i still don t know what happened between him the ownership a b general manager andrew berry stefanski obviously it was unfixable mayfield meanwhile has moved on to greater success in tampa bay where he s won two nfc south titles and a playoff game with the buccaneers and where he recently signed his second lucrative extension and has made a home he s carrying all of us zampese said he just got rewarded for the job he s done and we all have great confidence in him doing an even better job as we move forward and i know he does too mayfield will receive his second opportunity to exact revenge on his former team sunday browns fans will do their best to cover their eyes

news_mentions.headline: Caleb Williams, Bears prepare for 'mental war' against DC Brian Flores, Vikings
news_mentions.description: Fresh off a fantastic season debut and a 59-point explosion, the Bears return home to host the Vikings. The challenge ahead includes countering one of the NFL's most aggressive and exotic defenses.
news_mentions.body_text: fresh off a fantastic season debut and a 59 point explosion the chicago bears return home to host the minnesota vikings the challenge ahead includes countering one of the nfl s most aggressive and exotic defenses directed by coordinator brian flores in simple terms it s an unstoppable force meeting an immovable object from bears coach ben johnson s perspective it s more of a war of attrition with the opposition targeting a key resource emotion coach ben johnson calls this mental war when you go against versus him and that s what it is bears quarterback caleb williams said wednesday via espn you ve got to be able to go out there and bad things are going to happen you ve got to be able to fight back and stay steady that s one of the biggest things is not allowing his defense and all of that to fluster you and get in your mind you stay steady and now it s time to go make plays and get completions and when the big ones show up take them and find them williams certainly took plenty of the big plays in week 1 chicago piled up 552 yards of offense williams completed 21 of 29 passes for 269 yards and two touchdowns and added two more rushing scores of his own including a dazzling 29 yard sprint to the end zone just before halftime for one week everything worked chicago knows the going won t be that easy against minnesota the vikings delivered their own avalanche of sorts on sunday but on the defensive side of the ball sending a flurry of blitzes at packers quarterback jordan love that powered a 22 point fourth quarter and a 17 point win in a game that had previously appeared destined to end in defeat in one half flores defense reminded the rest of the nfl of its strengths the two clash sunday in a contest that will test the bears preparation and ability to adjust quickly you don t johnson said with a laugh when asked wednesday how he can predict how flores might approach the game you try to have answers for everything he s been in this division three years now and yeah i mean you d like to think he s put everything he could possibly do on tape until you play him next and you realize he hasn t yet so it ll be something new there always is with him and that s what makes him such a good coordinator it s a great challenge it really is you have a lot of fun on game day now the week of preparation is not so much fun but you know there s a lot of back and forth that goes into it with only one week complete there s plenty left to discover in this new nfl season johnson hasn t been shy about his record breaking goals for his offense in 2026 and after one week it seems the bears are on track to accomplish them scoring every drive is our mindset williams said that s the potential of us that s an internal expectation that s an internal feeling just of what we have up front out wide and in the backfield it s an expectation from ourselves to be able to go out there and score every time and figure out ways to help the defense that s our part to help this team help special teams is scoring points as many as we can on as many drives that we have that s our challenge we ll learn whether that s still realistic after these two heavyweights collide sunday

news_mentions.headline: Cowboys HC Brian Schottenheimer on George Pickens' Week 1 drops: 'I don't worry about George'
news_mentions.description: During the Cowboys' season-opening 28-20 loss to the Giants, George Pickens had a pair of drops. He's not worried about them, and neither is his head coach.
news_mentions.body_text: though the dallas cowboys defense was saddled with ample scrutiny in the squad s season opening loss to the new york giants the offense was hardly guilt free george pickens in particular struggled with a pair of drops during an underwhelming performance pickens had a step on his defender with less than 90 seconds to go in the first half of a tie game but dropped a would be big gain on third and 4 for his second bobble three days later pickens shrugged off the gaffes quick to turn the page to week 2 and a now pivotal matchup against the rival washington commanders in dallas home opener it s football pickens said via the team website you re gonna have something here you re gonna have something there but you definitely wanna limit those and to make the big plays because that s what i know what i m capable of football is football and i m just trying to get better coming off a debut season with dallas that stands as his best career year pickens had just three catches for 28 yards on seven targets in the cowboys 28 20 loss to the giants pickens head coach isn t concerned about his pro bowler s performance confident he ll rebound george will be just fine brian schottenheimer said wednesday he s gonna usually catch that ball going down the sideline and probably pull through it then jump over people and spin and then jump into the end zone so i don t worry about george catching on quickly is the onus though should the cowboys fall to 0 2 and do so by losing to another nfc east opponent it would surely raise the panic meter in dallas forth worth it s definitely urgent because it s another division game such as the giants was said pickens who posted career bests of 93 receptions 1 429 yards and nine touchdowns in 2025 after he was traded by the pittsburgh steelers we definitely need to nail down our p s and q s i think that s the mindset that people are honing in now the cowboys defense allowed 394 yards to the giants who scored a touchdown in each quarter dallas offense countered with just 244 yards of offense struggling out of the gate and held to just two second half possessions there s a lot that needs improving in week 2 and beyond unsurprisingly pickens is confident that improvement will show on sunday we probably as a team all can get better he said and we will when we come out this weekend

news_mentions.headline: Next Woman Up: Izzy Diaz, Harriet P. Irsay Fellow/Special Teams Assistant for the Indianapolis Colts
news_mentions.description: In this installment of the Next Woman Up series, Colts Harriet P. Irsay Fellow/Special Teams Assistant Izzy Diaz discusses the importance of special teams, her dreams of becoming a head coach and more.
news_mentions.body_text: women are rising up the ranks throughout professional football earning positions of power in a space that for too long was ruled almost exclusively by men we re seeing more and more women breaking barriers in the sport but what are the stories beyond the headlines who are the women shaping and influencing the nfl today answering those questions is the aim of the next woman up series while the conversational q as are edited and condensed for clarity this is a forum for impactful women to share experiences in their own words without further ado we introduce izzy diaz indianapolis colts position harriet p irsay fellow special teams assistant let s start at the beginning how did you get your start in a career in football my start came purely from the love of the game my mom tracy hopkins is a flight attendant so i spent a lot of time with my grandparents my grandpa ray hopkins would start every sunday by reading the newspaper eating a donut and drinking coffee he loved to point out the football standings and team names the next thing i know i m sitting on the couch watching fox nfl sunday and begging to stay up late for the sunday night football games and how did you arrive in this role when i was about 9 years old i loved football and wanted to play it but my mom said no so i looked at her and said i want to coach football then she was supportive and didn t question that so in high school i got involved with the football program videoing the team at practice i was also a cheerleader so i was at the games and i begged the coaches to let me sit in on the game plan meetings on the weekends the head coach brian brazil who s now passed was the first coach to look at me and tell me i was going to be a trailblazer in this space he told me the staff was all hands on deck and would help me i found that oklahoma state had a sport and coaching science major and sure enough they were the first team to send coaches to our spring practices i got called down to the field house and i went straight up to dan hammerschmidt who was the dbs coach for oklahoma state at the time i shook his hand and told him i wanted to be in his shoes one day it was awesome so i got to oklahoma state and took the same route as i did in high school i videoed my first two seasons and in the spring of my sophomore year i started as a defensive student assistant working with the defensive backs i already sat in their meetings when i was videoing practice and games zack ramsey the head video coordinator at osu helped me tremendously he was willing to help in any way he could sitting in those meetings was like learning a new language i eventually got to be a defensive assistant under defensive coordinator jim knowles and head coach mike gundy i had an incredible support team around me i participated in the nfl women s forum over zoom and ron rivera was part of it and called me afterward to intern with the washington commanders it was an incredible experience and i got my feet wet in otas and training camp in the summer of 2022 i got invited back to the women s forum the next spring and that s when i met colts owner and ceo carlie irsay gordon and john park who was our director of football research at the time they encouraged me to apply for the tony dungy fellowship program as i was applying for that the harriet p irsay fellowship was created and i am honored to be the inaugural person to receive that fellowship i m in my fourth season as the fellow and a special teams assistant that s great so what does that role entail our special teams coordinator brian mason and special teams senior assistant joe hastings are incredible so i try to make their lives as easy as i possibly can i do a lot of our practice scripts and depth charts at practice i run our look teams and assist with our gunners and returners and i work on our opponent drawings advanced scouting reports and breaking down and inputting film for game planning purposes on game day my main responsibility is making sure we have 11 players on the field i ll never forget there was a game two years ago i heard the guys upstairs say you have 12 my whole body sunk and i was thinking there s no way we ended up having 10 guys because otherwise it would have been a penalty if there were 12 i also do charting which entails a lot of details i learned a lot of these skills at oklahoma state i like to think of it as a toolbox and it needs to be full with all of the skills you might need and what is the most challenging part about your job the most challenging part is we have so many special teams units so keeping everything organized and prioritizing tasks it s easy to get flooded with a lot of things at once so you have to have a plan and order to get things done staying ahead is another challenge the goal before the end of training camp was to have our first four or five opponents broken down for practices it makes my life a little easier once we get into the season i want to ask specifically about the importance of special teams it can get overlooked at times by football fans why is that phase of the game so important and what is your favorite aspect of it i like to look at it as a bridge between offense and defense because special teams is trying to put those units in an advantageous position when they begin drives getting points on the board with field goals and pats and returns for touchdowns and preventing those scores are so important because so many games are decided by a few points the hidden yardage teams get from special teams units also adds up one of my favorite parts of special teams is that guys make the roster that way there is so much value in being able to play special teams in january i was the special teams coordinator for the 2026 east west shrine bowl and i learned so much from marquice williams head coach for the game s east team and current senior special teams assistant for the las vegas raiders he told me players aren t just running backs or wide receivers anymore they are football players they have to bring special teams value because there are only 53 players on the roster it helps players with the longevity of their careers because if you don t bring that value you re the third or fourth in the depth chart at your position you re on the bubble of making the roster it s the best when you see primarily special teams players earn bigger roles on offense or defense i love that answer i know you re still early in your career but what have you learned about yourself that i am capable of excelling at this job for me to go from being the third person in our special teams group to be named the coordinator at the east west shrine bowl i really had to show that i could do it i am in the same office as brian and joe hearing all the discussions and watching how brian game plans and does the depth chart so i knew what to do i just had to do it i m slowly getting more confident when i m talking to players finding my coaching voice and learning my own special teams philosophy i ve also learned it s ok to make a mistake but just don t be a repeat offender that s something carlie irsay gordon has talked about we re all human so mistakes will happen but how are you going to bounce back have there been times when you thought maybe this dream wasn t going to happen and how did you overcome that this is a tough question to answer because if i m being honest not really i have always been so passionate about football and i ve never seen myself doing anything else it s almost like a horse in a race they have blinders on that was me there have been challenges along the way but i learned to advocate for myself and find my voice my favorite piece of advice and i continually say and live by it is closed mouths don t get fed you have to be willing to speak for yourself and ask questions so i hate to say that there really wasn t a moment where i didn t think this dream was possible that makes a lot of sense now along those lines do you have any mentors and what advice have you received from them there s been mentors at every spot brian brazil and jeff hill in high school their advice to me was if you re going to pursue this career do it and don t take a year off if i was unable to get a job one year they told me just be around the game and keep learning at oklahoma state it was mike gundy jim knowles and bradley thomas thomas was our defensive assistant but an offensive minded guy i learned both sides of the ball from him and he was someone who challenged me and threw me into the fire at times i also worked with former oklahoma state defensive coordinator derek mason who helped me network taught me to be present and do my tasks to the best of my ability so i would be ready for an opportunity when it came he would tell me i was going to run a certain drill at practice and i was freaking out internally but if i didn t have those experiences and learn how to handle chaos i wouldn t know how to handle situations now with the colts then with the colts shane steichen is incredible and both brian and joe are incredible mentors i could not do my job right now if it weren t for them and their mentorship and trust in me i would add the female coaches in the nfl are mentors as well i have a relationship with some of them and the biggest thing is confront the challenges and keep doing your job i ve been so blessed our owners carlie casey foyt and kalen jackson are such stewards for women in football and for our team seeing them in their roles is so important and valuable to me you ve received some great advice so let s flip it forward what advice do you have for women who want to pursue a career in coaching first it s closed mouths don t get fed advocate for yourself get involved early in college because there are a plethora of opportunities you might have to start in a different area but get your foot in the door and learn everything you can you ve got to be a sponge and absorb information the last thing is believe in yourself which is something my mom taught me what is your end goal for your career i ve always said i want to be a head coach in the nfl that s always been the goal but i ve learned to make short term goals to hit my next goal is to be a true special teams assistant then a special teams coordinator or assistant to the head coach i ll definitely be following and lastly what are you most proud of i m proud of myself for not giving up i m proud to say i get to do my dream job i get to walk by the vince lombardi trophy every day before each game i walk two miles around the field and listen to beyonce s renaissance album i ve been doing this since my junior year of college i just reflect on my life and i m so proud my mom is at most of the games and my grandfather has been to some i want there to be a wave of women behind me and continue to see women in coaching roles i want to get to the point where there are no more firsts and it s not a huge deal anymore

news_mentions.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 2: Caleb Williams, Lamar Jackson and Trevor Lawrence soar into top five
news_mentions.description: Movement abounds in Nick Shook's QB Index, with prolific passers like Trevor Lawrence flying up the rankings as scattershot signal-callers like Drake Maye plummet. Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: i begin this qb index with a disclaimer with only one week s worth of evidence there is more volatility than usual reputation matters but so do recent results we re a long way from solidifying the standing of many of these quarterbacks and because we saw some unexpected outcomes in week 1 prepare yourself for some aggressive swings it ll even out eventually for now i have one bit of advice buckle up note up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 1 qb index tier 1 josh allen nearly blew buffalo s chances of scoring a huge week 1 win with an inexplicable yolo ball into the end zone late in the fourth quarter but houston cb kamari lassiter dropped the potential game sealing pick now that i ve put that on the record allow me to acknowledge that allen was otherwise marvelous in this contest he played all the allen hits in the bills 36 31 win he scored a rushing touchdown on a wild scramble connected with dj moore on a 43 yard touchdown pass scored another rushing touchdown from a yard out and directed a 96 yard touchdown drive with the game on the line capping it by firing a rocket between two defenders to josh palmer for the game winning score that s a great start to his annual mvp push next gen stats insight via nfl pro allen averaged 12 6 air yards per attempt his highest mark in a game since week 18 of 2022 and he was efficient pushing the ball downfield completing 11 of 16 attempts of 10 plus air yards for 286 yards and two touchdowns caleb williams remains one of the most thrilling joyous watches in the nfl he makes throws nobody else is capable of completing on a weekly basis and did so at least twice on sunday dropping a laser guided strike over two defenders to cole kmet for a touchdown and heaving an off platform missile to rome odunze to set up another score in the first game of williams third professional season i arrived at a new realization the 24 year old now deeply understands the timing and priorities of ben johnson s scheme and operates comfortably within its structure but much like a great guitarist caleb s artistic improvisation is what makes him special and elevates chicago s offense from very good to fantastic sunday s game included a collection of such examples producing thrills on the ground and through the air that have become part of williams brand next gen stats insight via nfl pro williams reached a top speed of 20 8 mph on his second touchdown run a 29 yard scamper in the final minute of the second quarter of chicago s 59 37 win over carolina lamar jackson raved about declan doyle s offense as a breath of fresh air entering the new season perhaps he should have described it as a hurricane because baltimore destroyed indianapolis on sunday jackson played an integral part throwing for 324 yards by leaning heavily on zay flowers early and distributing the ball fairly evenly after the star wideout left with a hamstring tweak it helped that everything worked for the offense but i won t let derrick henry s 144 yards take away from jackson s performance if this becomes the standard for the ravens expect jackson to own a firm place in the mvp discussion again things looked too easy for trevor lawrence and the jaguars who shredded cleveland s defense all afternoon in jacksonville parker washington jakobi meyers and even brenton strange all renewed their connection with lawrence who picked up right where he left off at the end of the 2025 season tier 2 this ranking isn t entirely based on one week s showing and this is where reputation mixes with results matthew stafford wasn t himself in the rams season opening loss to the 49ers in australia but the reigning nfl mvp wasn t all that awful surprisingly stafford finished with a completion percentage over expected cpoe of 2 5 bryce young played excellently on the other hand and leapfrogs stafford for perhaps the only time all season in fact let s take a second to dive a little deeper into young s performance a typically up and down quarterback young looked confident in his most aggressive game since he threw for 448 yards in carolina s week 11 win over atlanta last season most importantly young finally looked fully comfortable in dave canales offense made decisions with conviction and truly elevated carolina s offense was it enough to keep up with caleb williams bears no but it s worth tracking over the next month because it could heavily influence his contract talks with the panthers if this is a preview of what s to come next gen stats insight via nfl pro young threw for 289 yards and averaged 14 5 yards per attempt against zone coverage compared to 72 yards and 4 2 yards per attempt against man coverage in sunday s loss to chicago now back to the rest of the group patrick mahomes scored a rushing touchdown but it s clear he s not quite back to his old self in the mobility department which didn t help his passing efforts early in monday night s 31 10 win over denver that s fine when kenneth walker is shredding an opposing defense but kansas city can t count on that every week mahomes eventually found a rhythm in the second half and finished the game with a pair of td passes but i didn t expect him to start lighting up defenses through the air instantly this will probably be a slow burn dak prescott joe burrow and jared goff largely looked like themselves but at lower than usual outputs with prescott adding an uncharacteristic interception as a result of a failed throwaway attempt that led to a giants touchdown every quarterback is shaking off some rust in week 1 so there s no cause for alarm brock purdy was incredibly sharp in australia and confidently cooked the rams defense even after losing de zhaun stribling to injury the uncs of the world enjoyed watching him connect with three different thirtysomething receivers for touchdowns and i m sure purdy was happy to have mike evans on his side to start the season next gen stats insight via nfl pro purdy tied his career high with seven straight dropbacks when aligned under center no play action in week 1 against the rams completing all seven passes for 76 yards and two touchdowns including a 39 yard strike to demarcus robinson in the second quarter jalen hurts had a classic jalen hurts game in week 1 connecting on a handful of downfield shots while willing philadelphia s offense down the field with well timed scrambles against washington the eagles still need to be more consistent offensively on a per play basis but for one week hurts was able to carry them out of the muck to victory next gen stats insight via nfl pro hurts completed 6 of 9 downfield passes 10 air yards for 176 yards and three touchdowns in week 1 against the commanders his yardage on those throws was the eighth highest downfield total of his career while he threw three plus downfield touchdown passes for just the sixth time tier 3 remember how i said there would be some stunning volatility in the rankings this week well we ve reached that portion of the program i couldn t stomach dropping justin herbert any further because he still threw for 200 yards but that interception in the fourth quarter was ghastly and an unnecessary risk which we usually don t see from herbert especially when trying to climb out of a nine point hole tyler shough on the other hand shook off his early mistakes and let it rip in the second half throwing the saints back into a game that seemed destined to end in a lopsided loss i m not afraid to admit how much i m enjoying watching him progress as a starter he s fearless when the pressure is on and is developing a clutch gene that should entertain saints fans throughout 2026 it would be nice if their offense woke up earlier next time though next gen stats insight via nfl pro shough completed 8 of 11 passes against the lions blitz for 79 yards and three touchdowns in the second half and overtime after going just 2 of 7 for 17 yards with an interception and a sack fumble in the first half on downfield passes 10 air yards shough completed 11 of 16 attempts for 261 yards and a touchdown the most such yards by a saints quarterback since drew brees in week 6 2016 c j stroud played really well for most of sunday s close loss to the bills but bookending a good game with lost fumbles will knock you down the qb index jordan love lands in the same category after singlehandedly carrying the packers offense through three quarters then crumbling beneath the pressure applied by brian flores defense it wasn t his fault alone green bay s offensive line struggled significantly with picking up blitzes and stunts but as the director of the offense love needed to be better to stop the meltdown we only saw a handful of plays from sam darnold glute injury who lands ahead of jacoby brissett largely because he wasn t afforded much time to succeed or fail brissett certainly didn t fail powering a hungry cardinals offense by leaning on trey mcbride and even finding marvin harrison for a long completion on arizona s way to stunning the chargers next gen stats insight via nfl pro brissett completed 6 of 9 passes for 113 yards 23 9 cpoe on throws over 10 air yards in the cards upset win over the bolts drake maye s decent start completely fell apart in the fourth quarter and two of his three interceptions were solely his fault in terms of starts following an mvp runner up campaign this one will not be remembered fondly next gen stats insight via nfl pro all three of maye s interceptions came on deep attempts 20 plus air yards two more than he threw all last season one maye s interception on new england s final drive lost the patriots 47 9 win probability the most on a single pass attempt of his career geno smith did a lot to prove the raiders nightmarish situation was to blame for his ugly 2025 season benefitting from a strong offensive line in a very professional week 1 outing and kindling a new connection with adonai mitchell that deserves the eyes emoji jaxson dart delivered a similar performance and introduced the world to his new favorite target former ravens tight end and new new york star isaiah likely i m fascinated to see if the giants can sustain this level of success against better defenses than the cowboys revamped unit tier 4 when you sign up for a season with baker mayfield you know you ll have days in which his competitive streak and refusal to surrender will lead to multiple turnovers it happened twice on sunday with the first resulting in a defensive touchdown for the bengals and the second probably costing the buccaneers seven points baker giveth and taketh away but it s probably best it happened in week 1 not week 18 next gen stats insight via nfl pro mayfield averaged 4 7 air yards per attempt fourth fewest in a game in his career and 2 0 air yards per completion third fewest in the 33 27 loss to the bengals he completed 18 of 19 passes under 10 air yards for 134 yards and 5 of 8 passes over 10 air yards for 82 yards jayden daniels produced a mixed bag in philadelphia but the third year pro moved around confidently and delivered in key spots keeping washington in a tight contest that included a nice touchdown pass to stefon diggs and saw daniels lead the commanders on a 12 play 63 yard touchdown drive in crunch time most importantly he exited a pressure packed afternoon healthy next gen stats insight via nfl pro daniels was pressured on 19 of 38 dropbacks in week 1 against the eagles translating to a 50 0 pressure rate that tied his career high week 9 of 2025 vs seattle he went 15 for 19 with 138 yards and a touchdown when throwing from a clean pocket 78 9 completion percentage but just 3 for 15 with 26 yards and a touchdown when under pressure 20 0 aaron rodgers delivered one vintage moment when he rolled left set his feet and fired a bullet to pat freiermuth in the back of the end zone otherwise much of sunday saw rodgers try to force a connection with dk metcalf take many more deep shots than he did last season and finish with a passable at best performance at least he looked more like himself in mike mccarthy s offense next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers 9 2 air yards per target in sunday s 20 13 win over the falcons is the highest figure he has recorded as a member of the steelers with his 2 95 second time to throw mark representing his third highest average in a game with the franchise bo nix produced one truly impressive scoring drive and capped it with a pretty touchdown pass to evan engram to tie monday night s game at 7 7 that was it for the highlights the rest of the night included plenty of lowlights with nix appearing overwhelmed and out of sync amid a hailstorm of pressures generated by steve spagnuolo s defense next gen stats insight via nfl pro nix was pressured on 45 5 of his dropbacks against the chiefs his second highest pressure rate in a game in his career nix finished 2 of 10 for 5 yards and an interception under pressure with two strip sacks compared to 15 of 18 for 126 yards and a touchdown from a clean pocket kirk cousins played fine football against the lowly dolphins took what miami s defense gave him kept drives moving and finished three with touchdown tosses which meets the standard of expectation for him it also helped that raiders rb ashton jeanty became the dolphins most important problem cousins age showed in his performance though with the 38 year old throwing a couple of ugly interceptions and one dirt ball that saddened me because of how the man fell without getting touched as he threw it i think the wait for no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza won t last all that long daniel jones didn t move as much as usual in his first game back from a season ending achilles injury but it was difficult to put too much stock in his performance given how quickly the ravens buried the colts in a three score deficit he showed some rust in his decision making too forcing a pass into a window that didn t exist with roquan smith lurking underneath in coverage resulting in an interception malik willis did some nice things but was up and down at best and is clearly still acclimating to life as a full time starter his mobility is a weapon and helped him score a rushing touchdown he threw a handful of pretty passes and never looked especially overwhelmed he also threw a groaner of an interception and wasn t able to elevate the dolphins offense as they ll need him to in order to compete this season as far as debuts go it was passable given the surrounding circumstances but there s plenty of room to improve tier 5 kyler murray s debut in minnesota didn t last long included an interception on his first pass attempt a desperation heave fired under instant pressure and ended when he slid at the end of a short scramble was hit late drawing a flag and suffered a concussion leaving me with almost nothing to evaluate in the few snaps he saw prior to exiting there wasn t much to like cam ward s first game in brian daboll s offense was not the dream many fans hoped for the absence of a running game and ineffective pass protection limited ward who didn t handle the challenges well this process will take some time and will definitely include growing pains there were plenty in sunday s 23 10 loss to the jets next gen stats insight via nfl pro ward faced pressure on 42 1 of dropbacks the second highest rate of his career 50 in week 1 of 2025 vs denver under pressure ward completed 3 of 10 passes for 17 yards compared to 16 of 22 for 123 yards and a touchdown without pressure cooper rush was only effective on passes behind the line of scrimmage eliminating the downfield threat from atlanta s offense one target zero catches for kyle pitts and funneling the entire falcons attack through bijan robinson that understandably only worked early and once the steelers adjusted rush had nowhere else to turn succumbing to the pressure applied by pittsburgh s defense in an ugly low scoring loss he also didn t face a single man coverage snap somewhat of a slap in the face from the steelers defense which didn t fear rush enough to try to blanket falcons pass catchers in one on one matchups next gen stats insight via nfl pro rush did not complete a pass when pressured and particularly struggled when holding on to the ball for longer than 2 5 seconds completing 6 of 14 attempts for 83 yards while throwing two interceptions deshaun watson s numbers lied to you he looked just as slow to make decisions as he did in the preseason was consistently inaccurate especially when unsettled by the pass rush threw an awful interception on his third attempt of the season ran himself into pressures with remarkably deep pass drops and generally played like a quarterback who hadn t seen regular season action in two years todd monken told reporters he found plenty to like in watson s tape but the only example i can support was his downfield shot to rookie denzel boston for a touchdown in garbage time i think week 2 might be his last shot to prove he s still worth rostering that is unless monken stubbornly keeps rolling with him

news_mentions.headline: NFC North training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bears, Lions, Packers, Vikings
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top NFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Chicago Bears, Detroit Lions, Green Bay Packers and Minnesota Vikings.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers and minnesota vikings catch up on each nfc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers minnesota vikings three key storylines 1 can caleb find consistency we could discuss the bears offense taking another leap forward in ben johnson s second season we could consider the burgeoning potential of luther burden alongside rome odunze or ponder who will win the primary wr3 duties we could chatter about how much higher tight end colston loveland could fly or how johnson will use his diverse te room none of that really strikes a chord without caleb williams taking his game to new heights the former no 1 pick showed what the highs can look like in year 1 under johnson the explosive jaw dropping plays were plentiful and the qb led a trove of comebacks now he must flatten out some of the lulls the drive stalling misfires and become a more potent every snap quarterback keep the extraordinary peaks and raise the floor and williams will be in the thick of the mvp discussion the madden nfl 27 cover athlete heads into year 3 with heightened expectations if he meets them there is no telling how far the bears can go 2 defensive uncertainty from front to back questions on defense will hover over training camp the bears did precious little to upgrade a wanting front four the club added a few rotational interior defenders but is counting significantly on bounce back campaigns from grady jarrett and gervon dexter montez sweat still doesn t have a proven pass rusher on the opposite side austin booker showed signs down the stretch last year but can he take his game to another level is there enough down the line will shemar turner be healthy following last october s acl tear the questions up front are echoed on the back end where the bears are replacing both starting safeties coby bryant and cam lewis are solid but can they produce as many turnovers as the previous crew the key is first round pick dillon thieneman will the rookie be ready to thrive in dennis allen s scheme by week 1 3 two questions on the offensive line ozzy trapilo s patellar tendon injury in the wild card round means the bears can t count on the left tackle for at least the beginning of the season veteran braxton jones is penciled into the starting lineup but he will have to win the battle with jedrick wills and theo benedet to earn the week 1 assignment the position is one to keep an eye on the rest of the o line profiles as one of the better units in the nfl but if the left side becomes leaky it could be a cascading problem also i m going to keep tabs on the center spot the bears replaced drew dalman who abruptly retired this offseason with garrett bradbury as the presumptive starter however second round rookie logan jones could push the veteran for the starting gig during camp back to top three key storylines 1 offensive line overhaul the lions offensive line collapsed last season swiftly going from asset to liability detroit attacked the unit flipping penei sewell to left tackle drafting blake miller to man the right edge signing center cade mays and adding veteran depth at each spot how the line shakes out will be the main storyline to track during camp is sewell s transition going smoothly is miller a plug and play rookie or does he need time to adjust the key will be young guards christian mahogany and tate ratledge who struggled with consistency in 2025 will the duo improve or could they get pushed out of the starting lineup if the lions don t get better blocking in 2026 the explosive potential will be squandered 2 this is gibbs backfield sonic is now the featured character in detroit the offseason trade of david montgomery calcified the reality that jahmyr gibbs bell cow era is full go gibbs began to take over the majority of the backfield touches last season and his reps should continue to grow the lions likely won t want the dual threat back to creep to the 300 carry threshold but barring injury he ll blast past his career high of 250 totes gibbs should also see his role in the passing game continue to rise after posting a career best 77 catches for 616 yards and five touchdowns in 2025 gibbs combination of shiftiness speed and ability to make hay between and outside the tackles makes him a dynamic threat the lions want to ensure that threat stays on the field as much as possible he profiles for a christian mccaffrey type workload and should be in the offensive player of the year discussion by the end of the season with the expected rise in reps gibbs extension is also one we ve been waiting to see this offseason the lions have gotten in front of extensions in recent years so everyone expects a top of the rb market contract for gibbs to come barreling down the pike 3 can detroit return to health detroit has significant injuries to track at the onset of camp tight end sam laporta is the name to watch on offense but the defense has greater concerns brian branch suffered a late season achilles tear and while the lions haven t put a hard timeline on the safety s recovery it will be a surprise if he s good to go to open the season the bigger question is whether given the type of injury he sustained branch will be his normal buzzing self at all this season then there is kerby joseph whose knee injury limited him to just six games last season the lions have given few tangible updates on the safety s status while taking a wait and see approach without certainty from either starter the lions secondary sits in a precarious spot couple that with the release of cb terrion arnold and detroit could be relying once again on filler and journeymen in the defensive backfield back to top three key storylines 1 who rushes the passer until micah returns after tearing up his knee last december micah parsons is set to start camp on the physically unable to perform list and in all likelihood he ll start the season on pup wiping out his first four games there is always the chance parsons gets back earlier but given how he spoke about his timetable last month i expect him and the club to play it safe sans the dynamic pass rusher for the opening gambit there are significant questions up front in green bay the offseason trade of rashan gary made sense for the club but his absence further highlights a shallow edge group the packers need former first round pick lukas van ness to finally find his footing how he looks early in camp could tell us if green bay needs to add another veteran fourth round rookie dani dennis sutton also could have some say in that plan until parsons returns this might be a mix and match crew van ness is the key to whether the pack can survive the early portion of the calendar 2 jacobs uncertainty looms large josh jacobs situation continues to hover over the franchise after he was arrested in may at this stage it s unclear how local authorities will handle the situation in turn we don t know whether the league will take disciplinary action jacobs was on the field with his team last month and if things remain unchanged he should be there for camp if any action is taken against jacobs it could have a significant impact on the on field product in green bay jacobs is the workhorse and engine of the ground attack if he s unavailable or gets injured during the season matt lafleur s offense could be in some trouble next up are former undrafted free agent chris brooks a third down back and marshawn lloyd who has been unable to stay healthy the packers believe lloyd finally has turned a corner but until we see it in action that s a projection we can t assume we need to see the third year back produce during camp and into the preseason while staying healthy in the process 3 pass catching puzzle solved the pass catching unit in green bay is also something i m intrigued by the packers watched romeo doubs leave in free agency and traded dontayvion wicks then they inked jayden reed and christian watson to extensions those two and 2025 first rounder matthew golden comprise the top receiving trio with a clearer rotation at wr i believe the three can each thrive golden is the one to watch after he finished an uneven rookie campaign with a productive effort four catches for 84 yards and a score in the packers wild card weekend loss at chicago there are some depth questions particularly given the crew s injury history so that battle among reserves will be worth tracking tucker kraft s health is another piece to keep an eye on despite tearing his acl last november the pivotal playmaker is aiming to be ready for week 1 could he return with a new contract as well back to top three key storylines 1 kyler vs j j competition or coronation vikings coach kevin o connell continues to insist he s running a legitimate quarterback competition he keeps having to say it because frankly not many believe that j j mccarthy has a shot to keep kyler murray out of the starting lineup perhaps we ll be stunned but every indicator suggests it s murray s job to lose the former no 1 overall pick enters with proven ability while mccarthy has struggled when on the field and had issues staying healthy murray could open up the offense and his propensity to force feed his top targets could be a harbinger of a justin jefferson bounce back this competition in whatever form that takes will be tracked daily come camp within that context i m interested in how murray fits into koc s system and whether his mobility adds an element we haven t seen much of in minnesota over the past few years 2 next men up on the edge the trade of jonathan greenard took a chunk out of the defense not only because greenard was a proven disruptor but also due to the fact that the vikings now aren t very flush at the position dallas turner whom the club is counting on to have a full breakout in year 3 and andrew van ginkel sit atop the edge rusher corps but bo richter chaz chambliss and tyler batty are the next three players up on the depth chart they ve combined for one career sack chambliss defensive lineman tyrion ingram dawkins has also taken some reps on the edge the vikings could look to add another veteran rusher during camp or early in the season we trust brian flores defense but a coach who generally relies on vets who understand his system will be asking a lot out of youngsters how rookies caleb banks domonique orange jakobe thomas and charles demmings make the transition will have a significant say in the vikings outcome this season 3 one last dance with hitman we expected to have a resolution one way or the other on harrison smith s future surprisingly the situation still lingers will he return for another go or will he officially retire the club has made it clear they d welcome a return and didn t add a veteran to take smith s place jakobe thomas a third round pick was the only significant addition the club made to the safety crew given how much flores relies on the versatility of his safeties a return by smith would have a significant impact if he decides to retire jay ward theo jackson and thomas will battle for reps keep an eye on thomas and charles demmings in camp and preseason each could play key roles in 2026 back to top

news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top AFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Baltimore Ravens, Cincinnati Bengals, Cleveland Browns and Pittsburgh Steelers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the baltimore ravens cincinnati bengals cleveland browns and pittsburgh steelers catch up on each afc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below baltimore ravens cincinnati bengals cleveland browns pittsburgh steelers three key storylines 1 minter era begins john harbaugh is gone and in steps rookie head coach jesse minter to replace him baltimore needed a fresh start minter is the face of it but with a fresh start comes uncertainty is minter capable of preparing and directing his team toward the super bowl contention that has become the standard expectation in the charm city will the shift from harbaugh to minter a product of the harbaugh family coaching tree be enough to push the ravens back into the postseason or is the similarity between the two too close to produce meaningful change it s not often a team changes coaches and is still expected to compete for division titles and more but that s where the ravens find themselves and as is always the case with rookie coaches there s plenty of learning ahead for better or worse does this move boost baltimore back to the top of the division or will the ravens suffer another disappointing finish like in 2025 2 new oc for lamar with a new coaching staff in baltimore lamar jackson has a new offensive coordinator declan doyle is only 30 years old and less than a year older than jackson which could produce a deeper level of understanding between coach and quarterback but he s a largely unproven play caller doyle spent his first season as an oc under offensive mastermind ben johnson in chicago meaning he wasn t holding the play sheet now he will be jackson who is embracing the new system will need to adjust quickly and help the new coordinator establish a rapport with him in order to maximize the potential of the offense which returns derrick henry mark andrews zay flowers and rashod bateman among others baltimore must find a replacement for departed tight end isaiah likely but if doyle is anything like the coach he spent 2025 under the new oc should produce positive results even if it takes a bit to get going 3 a restored defense a hidden detail in the ravens 2025 struggles existed in their defense a unit that is traditionally a strength but was a sieve early in the campaign the main reason defensive lineman nnamdi madubuike went down with a serious neck injury exposing a weakness and lack of depth up front that rendered baltimore s d mostly ineffective except for the moments in which safety kyle hamilton played superhero to save the day that s not sustainable and the ravens acted accordingly this offseason signing trey hendrickson to restore a fearsome presence in the pass rushing unit madubuike could return in 2026 too and age defying defensive end calais campbell has rejoined the ravens to give them some much needed depth this is the group that minter will direct and regardless of what happens offensively this unit s performance will determine how far baltimore can go in 2026 back to top three key storylines 1 can defense finally deliver a year after navigating the choppy dramatic waters that came with trey hendrickson s holdout the bengals are in a much better place defensively they invested significantly in that side of the ball adding dt jonathan allen de boye mafe s bryan cook and s kyle dugger in free agency before swinging a major trade for dt dexter lawrence on paper cincinnati has finally upgraded defensively and appears poised to chase a super bowl but we all know depth charts only matter so much the bengals defensive inadequacies have led to great frustration in the midst of a third straight playoff less season last december joe burrow openly wondered about his football future largely because he was exasperated by the frequent challenges and predictable disappointments if the d is fixed there s reason to believe these bengals can return to the postseason and embark on a deep run 2 burrow s health can joe burrow stay healthy for once while most of the blame for this team s recent struggles has been rightfully pinned on the defense burrow s lack of availability has also been a near annual problem last season a toe injury required surgery and knocked him out for nine games sending the bengals into a crisis mode that prompted them to trade for joe flacco by the time burrow returned cincinnati needed to be nearly perfect to rescue its playoff hopes an impossible goal the flawed bengals failed to reach in 2023 a similar story played out when burrow missed cincinnati s final seven games due to a season ending wrist injury as is the case with every nfl franchise the bengals title hopes ride on the quarterback s availability that will continue to be true in 2026 3 taylor under major pressure the pressure is on cincinnati s head coach a defensible case could have been made for zac taylor s dismissal after 2025 instead he emerged as the only returning coach in the afc north entering 2026 this time around the usual excuses don t exist the defense is improved and if burrow stays healthy he has the pieces necessary to produce at an elite clip if cincy doesn t live up to the lofty expectations set by burrow the blame will fall on taylor s shoulders his team must succeed in 2026 there is no alternative three key storylines 1 new era begins under monken after six seasons the browns sent kevin stefanski packing terminating a two time nfl coach of the year who produced cleveland s only playoff win since the browns returned as an expansion franchise in 1999 in the same breath owner jimmy haslam opted to retain general manager andrew berry touting the personnel chief s strong 2025 draft class and strangely the improvement of kicker andre szmyt as justification for keeping him around berry responded by compiling another draft class that has plenty of potential in 2026 and continues to rebuild the franchise after overseeing the worst decision made by a gm in the last 25 years if not longer trading three first round picks for deshaun watson who also received a fully guaranteed 230 million contract berry replaced stefanski with veteran oc todd monken who makes his head coaching debut with a team that still isn t quite stocked for legitimate contention monken s arrival seems to have breathed new life into the young browns but with results pending that s all we know about the monken era as of now the most important lesson we could learn from the browns this year might be how much patience haslam possesses because it s unlikely this team will suddenly become a contender in 2026 it s up to monken to get the most out of his players in his first season at the helm 2 serious qb questions cleveland is revamping its offensive approach which had become rather stale under stefanski with monken in charge and travis switzer serving as a first time coordinator a new scheme can t cover for a lack of reliability at quarterback though the browns appear to be laying the groundwork for watson to emerge from irrelevance and regain the starting job while 2025 fifth round pick shedeur sanders lurks in the shadows how long watson holds on to the reins is another story but unless the 30 year old pulls off a miracle and returns to his houston form browns fans can prepare for another season filled with frustration under center which might play perfectly into a plan to select a top signal caller in 2027 s loaded draft 3 how will defense look without garrett and schwartz myles garrett reset the single season sack record in 2025 which proved to be his final campaign in brown and orange berry took a massive swing when he agreed to a forward thinking trade with the rams sending garrett to los angeles in exchange for young star edge rusher jared verse and a collection of picks that includes the rams 2027 first round selection garrett s departure means the browns lose 23 sacks worth of production from last season plus a persistent concern carried by every opposing offense add in the departure of respected coordinator jim schwartz and suddenly cleveland s defense its better side in the last two challenging seasons harbors plenty of questions fortunately the browns still have some studs on that side of the ball defensive rookie of the year carson schwesinger five time pro bowl corner denzel ward verse and promising sophomore defensive tackle mason graham but they re going to need to prove the personnel is strong enough to overcome a change in sideline leadership back to top three key storylines 1 no guarantees in life post tomlin mike mccarthy is back in the nfl having returned to his beloved hometown of pittsburgh to lead a steelers team that is taking on a much different appearance than usual instead of replacing one longtime coach with a young star the steelers opted for the veteran with super bowl experience in mccarthy a move some interpreted as a ploy to convince aaron rodgers to return for a 22nd nfl season if that was indeed the plan it worked whether it bears fruit however remains to be seen mccarthy s track record of directing explosive offenses should encourage steelers fans who have grown tired of watching low ceiling units struggle to compete so too should the acquisition of veteran receiver michael pittman but much of this feels like it s held together by chicken wire at least as of now pittsburgh s backup options behind rodgers are longtime reserve mason rudolph 2025 sixth round pick will howard and 2026 third rounder drew allar if crisis strikes at qb visions of a playoff victory something the steelers haven t achieved since the 2016 campaign will evaporate ideally the mccarthy rodgers partnership evokes memories of their days in green bay that s far from a guarantee along with the steelers annual assuredness to finish at or above 500 now that mike tomlin has left the coaching ranks for a job in television 2 run game concerns pittsburgh became one of the leaders in the nfl s sudden shift toward tight end reliant sets in 2025 leaning on the likes of darnell washington pat freiermuth jonnu smith and connor heyward to beef up and bulldoze opposing defenses though smith and heyward are no longer on the roster the first round selection of arizona state ot max iheanachor should help the ground game but is the backfield good enough jaylen warren is pittsburgh s lead back while rico dowdle arrives via free agency to give the steelers an explosive weapon capable of posting a few huge days as evidenced by his 389 yard outburst in weeks 5 and 6 for carolina last season kaleb johnson however remains a question mark the iowa product averaged just 2 5 yards per carry on 28 attempts as a rookie and hasn t yet proven he can be counted on as a rugged power back pittsburgh will have the hogs to move defenses and create rushing lanes but it will be up to mccarthy to deploy his personnel properly in order to stay on schedule and remain balanced especially with the largely immobile rodgers in the lineup 3 graham to get d back on track tomlin s departure meant the arrival of a new defensive coordinator and mccarthy selected the experienced patrick graham as his new director pittsburgh s defense is paid well but hasn t lived up to expectations of late finishing 26th in total d under former dc teryl austin in 2025 graham s track record isn t a slam dunk either in his last three stops dolphins giants raiders his defenses have hovered near league average peaking at 12th in 2020 with new york and bottoming out at 30th with miami in 2019 to his credit graham found some consistency amid dysfunction in las vegas over the last three seasons guiding the raiders to two 15th place finishes in 2023 and 24 before improving slightly to 14th but 25th in scoring d in 2025 he ll have better talent in pittsburgh which means the true test of his expertise should arrive in 2026 luckily he s working under a coach with a reputation for leading potent offenses if graham can prove himself to be a worthy dc then the steelers might actually be in business back to top

and the 2024 s season s best team the super bowl champion eagles in week 3 with both on the road nfl research what you need to know 1 on the heels of an nfc west championship season in which they took the eventual super bowl champion philadelphia eagles to the limit in the divisional round the rams are heading into 2025 with high hopes the addition of davante adams has only stoked expectations for a matthew stafford led offense a closer look offers a reminder that the rams offense was just 26th in total yards and middle of the road in points scored 17th just how quickly adams assimilates into rams have stacked up some stellar drafts they have piled up standout starters such as running back kyren williams 2022 fifth round defensive lineman kobie turner 2023 second wide receiver puka nacua 2023 fifth defensive lineman jared verse 2024 first dl braden fiske 2024 second and far too many more to list here in 2025 there s a lack of ballyhoo accompanying the latest class but with the rams recent track record it s enticing to see how these rookies come along considering l a s recent success drafting at certain positions it s arduous not to be fascinated by the potential of third round defensive end josaiah stewart fourth round rb jarquez hunter and seventh round wr konata mumpfield however the most intriguing could well be the highest picked tight end terrance ferguson the second round oregon product might be looked on to make an instant impact with tyler higbee yet to show he s fully back from a devastating knee injury and veteran colby parkinson regarded more for his blocking 3 every bit a bell cow back kyren williams had his second straight 1 000 yard campaign last season with his 1 299 yards equating to an nfl leading 73 6 of his team s rushing output those yards came on a career high 316 carries more than his rookie and second seasons combined 263 as williams and the rams work to a contract extension there s also reason to wonder if williams will see his role curbed a bit as l a has picked backs in back to back drafts blake corum 2024 jarquez hunter 2025 how williams contract situation plays out along with how the reps are divvied up in the l a backfield will be interesting plotlines to follow in southern california this summer

superstar out of the gate harrison and quarterback kyler murray furthering their chemistry could well be the team s prevailing storyline this season and that will get going in earnest during camp robinson picked 23 slots after harrison last year played in just six games because of a calf injury this will be a pivotal camp for him especially amid a revamped defensive front one that will offer him veterans to learn from and new faces to compete against for snaps 2 one of the easiest players in the nfl to root for calais campbell 38 returning to the team he began his illustrious career with in 2008 is more than just a feel great story campbell s leadership is just as important an addition as his talent to a club looking for its first winning season since 2021 this is a pivotal season for the monti ossenfort jonathan gannon regime and campbell pass rusher josh sweat and defensive tackle dalvin tomlinson should add some veteran moxie to a team lacking it outside of star safety budda baker gannon was hired for his defensive prowess coordinating the philadelphia eagles now his arizona d is finally stocked up at least on paper it s added some experienced talent and two high profile rookies in defensive lineman walter nolen first round no 16 overall and cornerback will johnson second no 47 johnson has the ceiling to become a massive draft steal how the cards defensive additions mesh with the starting staples begins this summer 3 james conner joined arizona in 2021 and has been a stellar fit who has exceeded his output and importance with the pittsburgh steelers for four years prior he s coming off career high tallies in carries 236 and rushing yards 1 094 but is entering his age 30 season 2024 third rounder trey benson 63 carries for 291 yards had a disappointing debut campaign but if he finds his footing could he push conner for touches it ll be interesting to see how camp develops in the arizona offensive backfield

performance center eagan minnesota fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs houston texans saturday aug 9 at 4 p m et nfl network week 2 vs new england patriots saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 at tennessee titans friday aug 22 at 8 p m et cbs 2025 schedule note the vikings will be the first team in nfl history to play a game in multiple international countries in the same season week 4 in ireland and week 5 in england nfl research what you need to know 1 it s all about j j mccarthy in minnesota the second year quarterback will be under the microscope as he takes over an offense that rejuvenated sam darnold s career last season the vikings decided not to buffer mccarthy with a veteran backup after daniel jones opted to sign with indianapolis apologies to the sam howell stans but he s not a threat to mccarthy the former first round pick inherited the porsche of offenses which has made almost every driver look good kevin o connell is a proven qb whisperer so the assumption is that mccarthy should have little trouble keeping things afloat with justin jefferson jordan addison t j hockenson and a remade offensive line the vikes offer weapons to aid the young signal caller minnesota is a 14 win club that on paper improved entering 2025 the loudest question is mccarthy and whether he can keep the engine humming after missing all of 2024 it s not hyperbole to suggest that mccarthy is the pendulum that could swing the course of the entire nfc north 2 the top camp battle in minnesota comes in the secondary heretofore the vikings have yet to add a veteran to the mix who could push for a starting gig next to byron murphy it feels as though the club could be waiting to see how mekhi blackmon bounces back after missing the entire 2024 season due to an acl tear isaiah rodgers blackmon and jeff okudah are in line to battle for the cb2 role elsewhere in the vikings secondary the club didn t replace no 3 safety camryn bynum who left for indianapolis this offseason defensive coordinator brian flores used three safeties liberally last season if he does so again would he trust the likes of theo jackson in that role could a veteran be added closer to the season 3 will the interior offensive line upgrades pay off the internal pressure proved to be sam darnold s undoing last year general manager kwesi adofo mensah set out to fix the issue signing veterans ryan kelly and will fries from indy then he drafted guard donovan jackson in the first round in theory the moves should solidify a leaky interior however kelly and fries are both coming off injury plagued seasons those concerns are coupled with star left tackle christian darrisaw coming off a season ending knee injury the offseason overhaul is excellent from a starter s perspective but there are questions among the second string crew should injuries strike again

news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the detroit lions offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 16 rookies july 19 veterans location detroit lions training facility allen park michigan fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule pro football hall of fame game vs los angeles chargers thursday july 31 at 8 p m et nbc week 1 at atlanta falcons friday aug 8 at 7 p m et week 2 vs miami dolphins saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 vs houston texans saturday aug 23 at 1 p m et 2025 schedule note the lions have 11 games against 2024 playoff teams tied with the eagles for most in the nfl nfl research what you need to know 1 who will replace frank ragnow the abrupt retirement of the star center tossed a massive question mark into the lions den presumably the club hoped to get one more year out of the stalwart pivot who played through an assortment of injuries throughout his career that would have allowed rookie tate ratledge to get his feet wet at guard before transitioning to center in 2026 much the same way ragnow started his career now things are turned topsy turvy is the second round rookie ready to start under center like 30 other second round picks he remains unsigned as camp approaches which could toss another kink into the lions plans can veteran graham glasgow return to center for the start of the season the 32 year old struggled last season at guard and hasn t consistently played center since the end of the 2022 campaign fifth round rookie miles frazier could also play a key role this season particularly if injuries strike with second year guard christian mahogany already slated to take over for guard kevin zeitler who left in free agency the lions could be uber young in the middle of the offensive line in front of jared goff a strength of the 2024 squad the offensive line has big questions heading into training camp 2 coming off a 15 2 season and back to back nfc north championships the lions are replacing both coordinators who left for head coaching jobs dan campbell knew he could trust ben johnson and aaron glenn to pull the right plays and build a reliable game plan week in and week out now he ll have to construct that same trust with new offensive coordinator john morton and defensive coordinator kelvin sheppard working under glenn since he became an nfl coach in 2021 sheppard was a natural choice to step into the dc role however he s green as a play caller and there will be questions about how he handles in game adjustments glenn kept a defense decimated by injuries afloat last season until the playoffs how would sheppard fare if similar devastation occurs likewise morton enters with big shoes to fill the lions offense was a dual threat nightmare for defenses and johnson was a master at setting up defenses to fail will morton who doesn t have a ton of play calling experience continue that with a trove of offensive weapons or could we see a step back from detroit s offense morton s familiarity with goff is a benefit but questions remain as to how he ll tweak the scheme like potentially splitting out wide jahmyr gibbs more often it s difficult to imagine the lions getting better management from their coordinators than they had a year ago any step back could be a detriment in a tough division training camp will give us our first real taste of how the new coordinators plan to change things or not in 2025 3 aidan hutchinson has been cleared from last year s devastating injury given the timeline it s not a surprise that the pass rusher is raring to go but it will be good to see him live during camp how he attacks those first few days of practice and recovers from them will give a good indication as to whether he can get back to the defensive player of the year trajectory he was on pre injury or whether we should curtail our expectations hutchinson s health isn t the only one to track in detroit alim mcneill is expected to miss the early part of the season but how much remains to be seen how does marcus davenport look after yet another injury shortened season there are questions at edge rusher in detroit so the health of the front four is particularly notable at this early stage
