across the nfc north catch up on the chicago bears offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 19 rookies july 22 veterans location halas hall lake forest illinois fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at miami dolphins sunday aug 10 at 1 p m et nfl network week 2 vs buffalo bills sunday aug 17 at 8 p m fox week 3 at kansas city chiefs thursday aug 22 at 8 20 p m et 2025 schedule note the bears are one of just seven teams that are not scheduled to play on a thursday this season however they will play the eagles on black friday nfl research what you need to know 1 a new hope wafts through chicago like a dense fog rolling in off lake michigan the arrival of ben johnson created a palpable buzz around the bears that an offense perpetually stuck in the mud might finally take flight johnson proved in his three seasons calling plays in detroit that he can manufacture explosives on the ground and through the air it was more than just the gadget or trick plays johnson s intelligence and play sequencing are some of the best in the nfl like a good boxer who can set up a knockout punch johnson knows how to counter a defense the bears stealing johnson from a division rival is the most significant coup for quarterback caleb williams who experienced a rollercoaster rookie season it s been an incredible offseason for williams his new coach and offense are a massive improvement the offensive line was dramatically rebuilt and should be the most improved blocking group in the league the additions of tight end colston loveland and wide receiver luther burden provide dynamic playmaking to grow with the young signal caller everything is built for williams to thrive in 2025 hey maybe the bears will finally join modern football with a qb throwing for 4 000 yards for the first time in club history one question entering camp is the running back rotation chicago didn t add a back until kyle monangai in the seventh round will d 39 andre swift bounce back behind a better offensive line will roschon johnson play the david montgomery role in johnson s offense we know the new coach wants to lean on the ground game to springboard the passing attack but does he have the horses in chicago 2 the bears drafted three second rounders in 2025 normally that s not a notable fact in mid july however this season there is a holdup on second round picks signing their contracts as of publication 30 remain unsigned the delay stems from the top two second rounders receiving fully guaranteed contracts the first in nfl history to do so for the bears the standoff is significant with receiver luther burden offensive tackle ozzy trapilo and defensive tackle shemar turner all in line for prominent roles out of the gate editor s note turner agreed to his rookie contract on thursday after this story was published if the issue remains unresolved pushing into august we could see the rookies presence early in the season curtailed bears fans will remember roquan smith starting his rookie season on a pitch count after an elongated contract dispute missed time in camp is significant for first year players we haven t seen burden on the field since he suffered a soft tissue injury in rookie minicamp trapilo could be in a position to battle for the left tackle gig if braxton jones isn t healthy 3 the biggest camp battle in chicago could be the left tackle job braxton jones fractured his ankle in december and didn t participate this offseason jones was solid in 2024 allowing 26 pressures in 12 games the injury could open the door for ozzy trapilo to swipe the gig particularly if jones isn t healthy to open the season obviously if the second rounder remains unsigned and jones can t practice the lt gig becomes an even bigger question 2024 third round pick kiran amegadjie struggled mightily when tossed into the fire last season but should get a clean slate under ben johnson another competition to keep an eye on is at the corner position where tyrique stevenson will attempt to avoid being unseated by terell smith and rookie zah frazier for the starting gig opposite jaylon johnson and nickel back kyler gordon

their monday night matchup with san francisco in week 12 is currently slated to be their only prime time game of the 2025 regular season nfl research what you need to know 1 bryce young s growth in the last half of 2024 was the silver lining of yet another lost season in carolina and furthering his development will be a primary focus over training camp the panthers helped that cause in april with the first round selection of tetairoa mcmillan who possesses the typical traits of a true no 1 wide receiver and offers young a rangy target as the quarterback enters year 3 establishing chemistry with mcmillan is crucial for an immediate impact and having veteran adam thielen around figures to aid that process xavier legette s development entering his second season is also essential to forming a dynamic group weapons for young to utilize hunter renfrow s comeback attempt in carolina is another subplot to keep an eye on over the summer as the panthers aim to build around their franchise quarterback 2 derrick brown s return in 2025 won t be only thing to anticipate for the panthers defense defensive linemen tershawn wharton and bobby brown are key free agent additions joining carolina s star defender and the initial gelling of this reimagined defensive front is worth monitoring the panthers lacked any push without brown who suffered a season ending knee injury in week 1 and their run stopping troubles spiraled into last season s 32nd ranked defense a turnaround up front could do wonders for a unit with a talented secondary headed by jaycee horn and mike jackson the panthers also added pass rusher patrick jones and safety tre 39 von moehrig via free agency rookies nic scourton and lathan ransom are also in the mix for playing time 3 kickoff and punt returns might bring some added excitement along carolina s preseason both primary roles are up for grabs this summer and a pair of rookies wr jimmy horn and running back trevor etienne are expected to compete for both jobs the pairing is small in size but brings plenty of speed and shiftiness to a club that has produced just one touchdown return since 2018 the panthers oncoming work on special teams doesn t stop with figuring out the returners either with new kickers matthew wright and ryan fitzgerald battling for the starting role and new punter sam martin holding for longtime long snapper j j jansen

news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc east catch up on the philadelphia eagles offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies veterans location novacare complex philadelphia fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs cincinnati bengals 7 30 p m et on thursday aug 7 week 2 vs cleveland browns 1 p m et on saturday aug 16 nfl network week 3 at new york jets 7 30 p m et on friday aug 22 2025 schedule note the eagles are the only team currently scheduled to play on five or more days of the week during the 2025 regular season sunday monday thursday friday saturday the chargers are set to play on four different days with the possibility of a fifth if their week 17 game currently tbd takes place on saturday nfl research what you need to know 1 there aren t many holes on the eagles roster entering the 2025 season that s what you d expect from the reigning super bowl champions with one of the youngest nuclei in football but there are a number of questions to be answered on the defensive side of the ball after a slew of departures out are josh sweat oren burks darius slay and chauncey gardner johnson four super bowl starters plus milton williams and the retired brandon graham that s 4 070 combined defensive snaps regular season and postseason and a lot of experience for which to compensate even for roster building whiz howie roseman and defensive guru vic fangio philly has backfilled well with its own talent plus a few notable additions in first rounder jihaad campbell pass rushers josh uche and azeez ojulari and cornerback adoree 39 jackson but how and how quickly the new look unit gels will be the focus of camp 2 what does saquon barkley s sequel look like after his historic 2 000 yard debut season with the eagles the madden nfl 26 cover athlete has reached the pinnacle of his sport with not much left to conquer the super bowl champ s renegotiated 20 6m aav deal is now the most expensive ever for a running back philly returns the same offense this season priming barkley for another opportunity to gash defenses behind arguably the league s top offensive line the eagles will likely lighten the star rb s load in training camp and preseason potentially save for an aug 13 joint practice with cleveland but if he shows the same burst and ability after an offseason of celebration could we be looking at our first two time 2k rusher 3 the eagles boast great continuity on the offensive roster but they ll have a new play caller and coordinator in 2025 kevin patullo was promoted to offensive coordinator after kellen moore left to be the saints head coach essentially minutes after their super bowl victory patullo will be philly s fourth offensive coordinator in as many years under nick sirianni shane steichen left for indy after the 2022 campaign and brian johnson was bounced after 23 the annual turnover at oc is historic sirianni is the first head coach to have four different ocs excluding interims in a four season span for one team since the merger and yet the eagles offense remains remarkably proficient year to year will that change with patullo s elevation he s been around the team since 2021 through the highs and lows of two super bowl berths and one embarrassing collapse our first glimpse at philly s identity under patullo will come in camp this summer

news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Jeremy Bergman provides a refresher on the New York Giants' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc east catch up on the new york giants offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 15 rookies july 22 veterans location quest diagnostics training facility east rutherford new jersey fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at buffalo bills 1 p m et on saturday aug 9 nfl network week 2 vs new york jets 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 nfl network week 3 vs new england patriots 8 p m et on thursday aug 21 prime video 2025 schedule note despite finishing the 2024 season tied for the worst overall record the giants enter the 2025 campaign with the hardest strength of schedule in the league for context the two other three win teams from last season the browns and titans rank 13th and 29th in sos respectively nfl research what you need to know 1 not quite the four headed monster in cleveland the giants quarterback quartet will still be an oddity to watch this summer tommy devito is the lone returning signal caller from 2024 but is slated to be qb4 if that by season s beginning new york imported two charismatic leaders in russell wilson and jameis winston with the former expected to take starting reps throughout the summer the giants also added rookie jaxson dart trading back into the first round to get brian daboll s guy there are too many cooks in the kitchen in east rutherford new jersey but the recipe for success is there wilson and winston show dart how it s done displaying different ways to lead and play in the nfl devito downloads his knowledge of daboll s system to the new trio dart makes incremental progress and eventually takes over for wilson midway through a grueling regular season will someone or something unexpected a trade spice up the narrative this summer 2 dart s shock selection diverted the excitement around the giants first first rounder no 3 overall pick abdul carter but the penn state product will take center stage this summer as part of a fearsome foursome up front pairing with fellow pass rushers brian burns and kayvon thibodeaux and star interior lineman dexter lawrence carter s addition gives the giants their best pressure pack since the nascar units drove new york to two super bowl titles in the eli manning era against an offensive line looking to re establish itself the pass rush should get a lot of opportunities this summer to show off and cause havoc in the giants qb quarrel during joint practices and maybe even in some preseason games 3 the culture change on new york s offense will trickle down from the revamped qb room but what to make of the rest of the giants attack aside from star 24 rookies malik nabers and tyrone tracy the cupboard is pretty bare at the skill positions wan 39 dale robinson darius slayton and zach pascal help fill out the wr corps with a number of jobs up for grabs cam skattebo is an exciting or at least name brand addition at rb but how big a factor will the rookie play this summer and fall the tight end corps is anonymous the offensive line returns its starting five from last year but could be in flux with former starting tackle evan neal moving inside to guard and andrew thomas returning from a season ending injury with daboll and general manager joe schoen s job on the line again this season n y needs this offense to be running at full speed out of the gate a summer addition at wr could be in the offing regardless expect a lot of moving and shaking before week 1

material_news_signals.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 2: Caleb Williams, Lamar Jackson and Trevor Lawrence soar into top five
material_news_signals.description: Movement abounds in Nick Shook's QB Index, with prolific passers like Trevor Lawrence flying up the rankings as scattershot signal-callers like Drake Maye plummet. Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
material_news_signals.body_text: i begin this qb index with a disclaimer with only one week s worth of evidence there is more volatility than usual reputation matters but so do recent results we re a long way from solidifying the standing of many of these quarterbacks and because we saw some unexpected outcomes in week 1 prepare yourself for some aggressive swings it ll even out eventually for now i have one bit of advice buckle up note up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 1 qb index tier 1 josh allen nearly blew buffalo s chances of scoring a huge week 1 win with an inexplicable yolo ball into the end zone late in the fourth quarter but houston cb kamari lassiter dropped the potential game sealing pick now that i ve put that on the record allow me to acknowledge that allen was otherwise marvelous in this contest he played all the allen hits in the bills 36 31 win he scored a rushing touchdown on a wild scramble connected with dj moore on a 43 yard touchdown pass scored another rushing touchdown from a yard out and directed a 96 yard touchdown drive with the game on the line capping it by firing a rocket between two defenders to josh palmer for the game winning score that s a great start to his annual mvp push next gen stats insight via nfl pro allen averaged 12 6 air yards per attempt his highest mark in a game since week 18 of 2022 and he was efficient pushing the ball downfield completing 11 of 16 attempts of 10 plus air yards for 286 yards and two touchdowns caleb williams remains one of the most thrilling joyous watches in the nfl he makes throws nobody else is capable of completing on a weekly basis and did so at least twice on sunday dropping a laser guided strike over two defenders to cole kmet for a touchdown and heaving an off platform missile to rome odunze to set up another score in the first game of williams third professional season i arrived at a new realization the 24 year old now deeply understands the timing and priorities of ben johnson s scheme and operates comfortably within its structure but much like a great guitarist caleb s artistic improvisation is what makes him special and elevates chicago s offense from very good to fantastic sunday s game included a collection of such examples producing thrills on the ground and through the air that have become part of williams brand next gen stats insight via nfl pro williams reached a top speed of 20 8 mph on his second touchdown run a 29 yard scamper in the final minute of the second quarter of chicago s 59 37 win over carolina lamar jackson raved about declan doyle s offense as a breath of fresh air entering the new season perhaps he should have described it as a hurricane because baltimore destroyed indianapolis on sunday jackson played an integral part throwing for 324 yards by leaning heavily on zay flowers early and distributing the ball fairly evenly after the star wideout left with a hamstring tweak it helped that everything worked for the offense but i won t let derrick henry s 144 yards take away from jackson s performance if this becomes the standard for the ravens expect jackson to own a firm place in the mvp discussion again things looked too easy for trevor lawrence and the jaguars who shredded cleveland s defense all afternoon in jacksonville parker washington jakobi meyers and even brenton strange all renewed their connection with lawrence who picked up right where he left off at the end of the 2025 season tier 2 this ranking isn t entirely based on one week s showing and this is where reputation mixes with results matthew stafford wasn t himself in the rams season opening loss to the 49ers in australia but the reigning nfl mvp wasn t all that awful surprisingly stafford finished with a completion percentage over expected cpoe of 2 5 bryce young played excellently on the other hand and leapfrogs stafford for perhaps the only time all season in fact let s take a second to dive a little deeper into young s performance a typically up and down quarterback young looked confident in his most aggressive game since he threw for 448 yards in carolina s week 11 win over atlanta last season most importantly young finally looked fully comfortable in dave canales offense made decisions with conviction and truly elevated carolina s offense was it enough to keep up with caleb williams bears no but it s worth tracking over the next month because it could heavily influence his contract talks with the panthers if this is a preview of what s to come next gen stats insight via nfl pro young threw for 289 yards and averaged 14 5 yards per attempt against zone coverage compared to 72 yards and 4 2 yards per attempt against man coverage in sunday s loss to chicago now back to the rest of the group patrick mahomes scored a rushing touchdown but it s clear he s not quite back to his old self in the mobility department which didn t help his passing efforts early in monday night s 31 10 win over denver that s fine when kenneth walker is shredding an opposing defense but kansas city can t count on that every week mahomes eventually found a rhythm in the second half and finished the game with a pair of td passes but i didn t expect him to start lighting up defenses through the air instantly this will probably be a slow burn dak prescott joe burrow and jared goff largely looked like themselves but at lower than usual outputs with prescott adding an uncharacteristic interception as a result of a failed throwaway attempt that led to a giants touchdown every quarterback is shaking off some rust in week 1 so there s no cause for alarm brock purdy was incredibly sharp in australia and confidently cooked the rams defense even after losing de zhaun stribling to injury the uncs of the world enjoyed watching him connect with three different thirtysomething receivers for touchdowns and i m sure purdy was happy to have mike evans on his side to start the season next gen stats insight via nfl pro purdy tied his career high with seven straight dropbacks when aligned under center no play action in week 1 against the rams completing all seven passes for 76 yards and two touchdowns including a 39 yard strike to demarcus robinson in the second quarter jalen hurts had a classic jalen hurts game in week 1 connecting on a handful of downfield shots while willing philadelphia s offense down the field with well timed scrambles against washington the eagles still need to be more consistent offensively on a per play basis but for one week hurts was able to carry them out of the muck to victory next gen stats insight via nfl pro hurts completed 6 of 9 downfield passes 10 air yards for 176 yards and three touchdowns in week 1 against the commanders his yardage on those throws was the eighth highest downfield total of his career while he threw three plus downfield touchdown passes for just the sixth time tier 3 remember how i said there would be some stunning volatility in the rankings this week well we ve reached that portion of the program i couldn t stomach dropping justin herbert any further because he still threw for 200 yards but that interception in the fourth quarter was ghastly and an unnecessary risk which we usually don t see from herbert especially when trying to climb out of a nine point hole tyler shough on the other hand shook off his early mistakes and let it rip in the second half throwing the saints back into a game that seemed destined to end in a lopsided loss i m not afraid to admit how much i m enjoying watching him progress as a starter he s fearless when the pressure is on and is developing a clutch gene that should entertain saints fans throughout 2026 it would be nice if their offense woke up earlier next time though next gen stats insight via nfl pro shough completed 8 of 11 passes against the lions blitz for 79 yards and three touchdowns in the second half and overtime after going just 2 of 7 for 17 yards with an interception and a sack fumble in the first half on downfield passes 10 air yards shough completed 11 of 16 attempts for 261 yards and a touchdown the most such yards by a saints quarterback since drew brees in week 6 2016 c j stroud played really well for most of sunday s close loss to the bills but bookending a good game with lost fumbles will knock you down the qb index jordan love lands in the same category after singlehandedly carrying the packers offense through three quarters then crumbling beneath the pressure applied by brian flores defense it wasn t his fault alone green bay s offensive line struggled significantly with picking up blitzes and stunts but as the director of the offense love needed to be better to stop the meltdown we only saw a handful of plays from sam darnold glute injury who lands ahead of jacoby brissett largely because he wasn t afforded much time to succeed or fail brissett certainly didn t fail powering a hungry cardinals offense by leaning on trey mcbride and even finding marvin harrison for a long completion on arizona s way to stunning the chargers next gen stats insight via nfl pro brissett completed 6 of 9 passes for 113 yards 23 9 cpoe on throws over 10 air yards in the cards upset win over the bolts drake maye s decent start completely fell apart in the fourth quarter and two of his three interceptions were solely his fault in terms of starts following an mvp runner up campaign this one will not be remembered fondly next gen stats insight via nfl pro all three of maye s interceptions came on deep attempts 20 plus air yards two more than he threw all last season one maye s interception on new england s final drive lost the patriots 47 9 win probability the most on a single pass attempt of his career geno smith did a lot to prove the raiders nightmarish situation was to blame for his ugly 2025 season benefitting from a strong offensive line in a very professional week 1 outing and kindling a new connection with adonai mitchell that deserves the eyes emoji jaxson dart delivered a similar performance and introduced the world to his new favorite target former ravens tight end and new new york star isaiah likely i m fascinated to see if the giants can sustain this level of success against better defenses than the cowboys revamped unit tier 4 when you sign up for a season with baker mayfield you know you ll have days in which his competitive streak and refusal to surrender will lead to multiple turnovers it happened twice on sunday with the first resulting in a defensive touchdown for the bengals and the second probably costing the buccaneers seven points baker giveth and taketh away but it s probably best it happened in week 1 not week 18 next gen stats insight via nfl pro mayfield averaged 4 7 air yards per attempt fourth fewest in a game in his career and 2 0 air yards per completion third fewest in the 33 27 loss to the bengals he completed 18 of 19 passes under 10 air yards for 134 yards and 5 of 8 passes over 10 air yards for 82 yards jayden daniels produced a mixed bag in philadelphia but the third year pro moved around confidently and delivered in key spots keeping washington in a tight contest that included a nice touchdown pass to stefon diggs and saw daniels lead the commanders on a 12 play 63 yard touchdown drive in crunch time most importantly he exited a pressure packed afternoon healthy next gen stats insight via nfl pro daniels was pressured on 19 of 38 dropbacks in week 1 against the eagles translating to a 50 0 pressure rate that tied his career high week 9 of 2025 vs seattle he went 15 for 19 with 138 yards and a touchdown when throwing from a clean pocket 78 9 completion percentage but just 3 for 15 with 26 yards and a touchdown when under pressure 20 0 aaron rodgers delivered one vintage moment when he rolled left set his feet and fired a bullet to pat freiermuth in the back of the end zone otherwise much of sunday saw rodgers try to force a connection with dk metcalf take many more deep shots than he did last season and finish with a passable at best performance at least he looked more like himself in mike mccarthy s offense next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers 9 2 air yards per target in sunday s 20 13 win over the falcons is the highest figure he has recorded as a member of the steelers with his 2 95 second time to throw mark representing his third highest average in a game with the franchise bo nix produced one truly impressive scoring drive and capped it with a pretty touchdown pass to evan engram to tie monday night s game at 7 7 that was it for the highlights the rest of the night included plenty of lowlights with nix appearing overwhelmed and out of sync amid a hailstorm of pressures generated by steve spagnuolo s defense next gen stats insight via nfl pro nix was pressured on 45 5 of his dropbacks against the chiefs his second highest pressure rate in a game in his career nix finished 2 of 10 for 5 yards and an interception under pressure with two strip sacks compared to 15 of 18 for 126 yards and a touchdown from a clean pocket kirk cousins played fine football against the lowly dolphins took what miami s defense gave him kept drives moving and finished three with touchdown tosses which meets the standard of expectation for him it also helped that raiders rb ashton jeanty became the dolphins most important problem cousins age showed in his performance though with the 38 year old throwing a couple of ugly interceptions and one dirt ball that saddened me because of how the man fell without getting touched as he threw it i think the wait for no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza won t last all that long daniel jones didn t move as much as usual in his first game back from a season ending achilles injury but it was difficult to put too much stock in his performance given how quickly the ravens buried the colts in a three score deficit he showed some rust in his decision making too forcing a pass into a window that didn t exist with roquan smith lurking underneath in coverage resulting in an interception malik willis did some nice things but was up and down at best and is clearly still acclimating to life as a full time starter his mobility is a weapon and helped him score a rushing touchdown he threw a handful of pretty passes and never looked especially overwhelmed he also threw a groaner of an interception and wasn t able to elevate the dolphins offense as they ll need him to in order to compete this season as far as debuts go it was passable given the surrounding circumstances but there s plenty of room to improve tier 5 kyler murray s debut in minnesota didn t last long included an interception on his first pass attempt a desperation heave fired under instant pressure and ended when he slid at the end of a short scramble was hit late drawing a flag and suffered a concussion leaving me with almost nothing to evaluate in the few snaps he saw prior to exiting there wasn t much to like cam ward s first game in brian daboll s offense was not the dream many fans hoped for the absence of a running game and ineffective pass protection limited ward who didn t handle the challenges well this process will take some time and will definitely include growing pains there were plenty in sunday s 23 10 loss to the jets next gen stats insight via nfl pro ward faced pressure on 42 1 of dropbacks the second highest rate of his career 50 in week 1 of 2025 vs denver under pressure ward completed 3 of 10 passes for 17 yards compared to 16 of 22 for 123 yards and a touchdown without pressure cooper rush was only effective on passes behind the line of scrimmage eliminating the downfield threat from atlanta s offense one target zero catches for kyle pitts and funneling the entire falcons attack through bijan robinson that understandably only worked early and once the steelers adjusted rush had nowhere else to turn succumbing to the pressure applied by pittsburgh s defense in an ugly low scoring loss he also didn t face a single man coverage snap somewhat of a slap in the face from the steelers defense which didn t fear rush enough to try to blanket falcons pass catchers in one on one matchups next gen stats insight via nfl pro rush did not complete a pass when pressured and particularly struggled when holding on to the ball for longer than 2 5 seconds completing 6 of 14 attempts for 83 yards while throwing two interceptions deshaun watson s numbers lied to you he looked just as slow to make decisions as he did in the preseason was consistently inaccurate especially when unsettled by the pass rush threw an awful interception on his third attempt of the season ran himself into pressures with remarkably deep pass drops and generally played like a quarterback who hadn t seen regular season action in two years todd monken told reporters he found plenty to like in watson s tape but the only example i can support was his downfield shot to rookie denzel boston for a touchdown in garbage time i think week 2 might be his last shot to prove he s still worth rostering that is unless monken stubbornly keeps rolling with him

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 2 picks: Upset and score predictions, matchup breakdowns for every game
news_mentions.description: Can the Texans and Broncos bounce back from uncharacteristic performances in Week 1? Will the Bears and Ravens continue to score points in bunches? Who's on upset watch? Check out the Week 2 game picks!
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 2 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 p m et on thursday sept 17 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday sept 20 why dan picked the panthers week 1 offered a stark reminder about the current state of play if you can t score points in bunches wins are going to be hard to come by in 2026 the panthers demonstrated the ability to put the ball in the paint albeit in a 59 37 season opening loss to the bears the falcons could muster just 13 points with third string qb cooper rush at the helm against pittsburgh and they enter week 2 with no clearly defined answer as to which qb gives them the best chance to win undrafted rookie jack strand out of minnesota state moorhead was the only falcons qb not listed on wednesday s injury report although michael penix knee and rush back practiced while tua tagovailoa oblique did not head coach kevin stefanski has yet to announce a starter as of this writing editor s update cooper rush will start his second straight game for the falcons kevin stefanski announced on friday both teams have their own crises to figure out but as awful as carolina s defense looked against the bears and yes ejiro evero s crew was inept i think the bigger disaster is atlanta s quarterback situation if bryce young takes a step backward after a strong showing last week something that certainly can t be ruled out maybe the door opens for the falcons it s a shame to be wasting a group that includes bijan robinson drake london and kyle pitts but until i see potency from the falcons offense i m not going to like their chances most days why brooke picked the ravens well i ll be this is a ravens offense i can get behind lamar jackson derrick henry and zay flowers absolutely cooked in the opener to the tune of 506 total yards and 41 points one of the more eye popping stats from last week per ngs 110 of henry s 144 rush yards came before contact the third highest single game total of his career and he was hit at the line of scrimmage on just 8 3 percent of his carries the lowest rate of his ravens tenure i m all in on this star studded offense early in 2026 despite the lengthy midweek injury report the saints could very well be chasing points again on the road and tyler shough looks built to scratch and claw until the very end however you can t always count on a late surge in this league not against the ravens stout pass defense and not against a henry led baltimore run game that is sure to drain the clock why dan picked the bears we have our very early favorite for the coaching matchup of the year here with the bears offensive mastermind ben johnson facing off against vikings defensive genius brian flores who will emerge victorious in the battle between two men who seem to try to redefine the word aggressive on a weekly basis johnson has already stated he wants the bears to break the single season scoring record and he apparently meant it given that his team dropped 59 points on the panthers last week as for flores minnesota blitzed 78 3 percent of the time against the packers no other team had a blitz rate higher than 52 percent in week 1 for what it s worth caleb williams completed 9 of 14 passes for 142 yards and two touchdowns against the blitz last week he did not fare as well when flores sent a blitz at him 67 percent of the time in their last meeting a 19 17 bears win in week 11 of last season sunday s contest will give us a much better gauge on whether williams really has entered the elite tier i m on record as a believer why bobby picked the bengals let s start this off with a declaration that could immediately backfire cincinnati s defense will be the difference in this game it s only a one week sample size but the bengals appear to have constructed a unit that can properly complement joe burrow s offense cincy s defense actually scored the team s opening points of the 2026 season on a scoop and score by linebacker demetrius knight in the first quarter against the buccaneers the bengals went on to hold tampa bay under 200 passing yards 193 and 100 rushing yards 89 something they only accomplished once last year and that took them until week 17 if they can replicate something close to that performance on sunday their prospects versus the texans are promising houston s defense although stacked with talent at every level also notably looks vulnerable to a passer of burrow s caliber after giving up 36 points to josh allen and the bills the texans are sure to recalibrate defensively but cincinnati s offense also has room to grow burrow didn t play lights out against the bucs he threw for 254 yards and a touchdown but also tossed a pick six and ja 39 marr chase two catches for 12 yards was practically invisible yet the bengals 33 points still exceeded their last three openers combined 30 points if cincy has finally figured out how to bypass its typical early season woes look out why gennaro picked the patriots is new england doomed to suffer the infamous super bowl hangover last week s instant sb rematch was certainly headache inducing for the franchise in the first half the patriots struggled to sustain drives against a fierce seahawks defense hell bent on holding its ground after sam darnold s opening drive injury in the third quarter the pats lost a j brown to injured reserve and in the fourth quarter drake maye lost the game with three interceptions to his credit last season s mvp runner up immediately owned the meltdown saying his impatience cost the team a win patience is absolutely a virtue against this week s opponent while the steelers now have an offensive minded head coach in mike mccarthy they still feature the same wildly opportunistic defense with t j watt s pick six powering pittsburgh past atlanta to state the obvious maye must take care of the football a directive mike vrabel s undoubtedly hammering home in the 10 days between last week s road collapse and this sunday s home opener with a more composed effort from the 24 year old quarterback the reigning afc champs should be able to take care of business against a steelers squad that looks like it will continue to live in the bottom half of the league offensively why jeremy picked the jets the packers have lost six straight games their longest such streak since the george h w bush administration the jets enter a home game undefeated in season for the first time since 2018 pigs are flying but what about the pigskin on sunday in east rutherford this one is difficult to assess because green bay and new york s week 1 outcomes were so out of character both the packers and jets held leads for more than three quarters of play but green bay collapsed in unfathomable fashion against minnesota while new york ran over an overmatched titans team both results may well have been flukes or not the jets pass rush sent cam ward running for his life in week 1 and given how brian flores defense terrorized jordan love one can expect similar pressure success from new york at metlife stadium however love is a more composed qb with more established weapons going up against an untested gang green defense again unpredictable new york played from ahead all day long against tennessee running the ball down the titans throats but if the jets fall behind by two scores to the packers can they ride 14 personnel to a comeback to be fair green bay has held a two score lead in four of its last six games all losses so maybe a true toss up in the meadowlands goes to the team in green er white who should benefit from a fan base that hasn t been this hyped up for a week 2 home game since the rex ryan era why brooke picked the buccaneers the doctor ordered a nice prescription for the buccaneers after last week s turnover fest in the form of the browns who were abysmal in the opener i fully expect to see a more poised baker mayfield in his return to raymond james stadium and against the team that drafted him and sent him packing after four seasons cleveland trotting qb deshaun watson back out there doesn t exactly inspire confidence when you consider he ll face a todd bowles defense that blitzed at the third highest rate 48 6 percent in week 1 and that watson completed 2 of 5 passes for 20 yards and an int with two sacks taken when blitzed in week 1 it s a recipe for another frustrating day for browns fans bucs by multiple touchdowns why jeremy picked the eagles a week after green clad yankees stormed broadway took over the bars and stadium and cheered on a dominant win for the away side titans fans can expect the same again trade out geno smith and the jets for jalen hurts and the eagles and robert saleh s titans have another rout on their hands if they re not careful no quarterbacks have been better on the road in september than hurts and patrick mahomes 800 on their careers and the former is coming off a well balanced season debut losing landon dickerson the week before jeffery simmons is on the docket isn t a plus but replacing the banged up guard may be addition by subtraction the even greater mismatch could come on the other side of the ball where the worst offense in the league since 2025 is going up against a vic fangio led defense that has paced the nfl in opponent passer rating in the same span in their last four meetings fangio s eagles have held titans oc brian daboll s offenses to a combined 70 points with a 34 point giants outburst last year the lone exception to the dc s dominance in the battle wan dale robinson and a mobile quarterback jaxson dart played key roles in flipping that token tie toward daboll will ward and co deliver a similar result the odds are not in favor of nash vegas why gennaro picked the broncos the jaguars rollicked to a 24 point victory in week 1 while the broncos lost by 21 so what gives with this prediction well jacksonville got to open its season at home against lowly cleveland while denver had to travel to kansas city to face the division rival chiefs in prime time now don t get me wrong sean payton s squad stunk up arrowhead stadium this past monday night with kenneth walker running circles around the broncos vaunted defense while davis webb laid an egg in his debut as denver s offensive play caller but i view this battle tested team which boasts enviable continuity from last year s 14 3 roster as a major bounce back candidate in its home opener payton openly expressed his displeasure with webb s pass happy approach in k c so it s safe to expect a more balanced offense in week 2 that said the jaguars yielded the fewest rushing yards in the league last season so i don t see anthony campanile s defense getting completely gashed on the ground with well rounded teams on both sides this feels like a game that could come down to a few key plays that s where jaylen waddle enters the picture you re forgiven if you forgot about denver s blockbuster trade addition after all he caught one pass for 2 yards in his broncos debut but the explosive wideout was acquired to put denver s loaded roster over the top against fellow contenders i think he does just that on sunday why brooke picked the chargers the big concern coming into this contest is the health of chargers wr ladd mcconkey who s day to day with a ribs injury he sustained in the third quarter of last week s surprising loss to the cardinals it was alarming to see how little justin herbert had to work with after mcconkey s exit who steps up is anybody s guess quentin johnston tre harris marquez valdes scantling who reportedly is signing to the practice squad it s on mike mcdaniel to game plan a short term fix though maybe just handing the rock to omarion hampton is the answer history is on herbert s side as he s defeated this division foe more than any other franchise in his career not to mention jim harbaugh has never started 0 2 in his nfl or fbs coaching career that s all the convincing i need i liked what i saw from the raiders last week but it s tough to really assess their home victory over a rebuilding miami team that sorely lacks talent i do think the 2026 version of this offense is in good position to compete with a steady kirk cousins and ascending ashton jeanty leading the way but i m not putting all my eggs in this basket quite yet getting brock bowers knee back could tip the scales as could any number of big plays from either side why brooke picked the seahawks drew lock played adequately last week in relief of sam darnold glute throwing for nearly 200 yards and a touchdown can he deliver for a second straight game in what will be his first start since week 18 of the 2024 season lock and co likely will have to score more than 13 points to get it done look for them to continue leaning into the play action pass which oc brian fleury called on 10 of their 27 pass attempts 37 last week the fourth highest rate in the league in week 1 per next gen stats and while the hawks had only one explosive play 20 plus yard completion on those 10 play action dropbacks the cardinals defense didn t exactly thrive in that area in week 1 either arizona gave up six catches on seven such attempts and 10 5 air yards per target ninth highest in the nfl against the chargers this is where seattle s offense could find more success with lock under center as impressed as i was with mike lafleur s balanced and efficient offense last time out i m unsure whether jacoby brissett jeremiyah love and friends can move the ball as easily against mike macdonald s vaunted defense specifically the secondary that unit which smacked the pats in the mouth again sets the tone and can help seattle tread water until darnold returns why jeremy picked the cowboys the runts of the nfc east through one week open up the at t stadium slate with a lot at stake considered by many as division favorites dallas comes into sunday looking for its third offensive possession in as many quarters it s not a good sign that the cowboys defense couldn t get off the field in prime time after an offseason of hyping up christian parker but that s not the only unit with a first time coordinator who didn t have a perfect week 1 david blough s commanders offense couldn t handle philly s pressure last sunday allowing an nfl high 50 percent pressure rate on jayden daniels and so a stoppable force meets a moveable object in arlington on the other side of the ball the explosives should come for dallas after its week 1 dud nearly shut out by the giants in that realm last sunday night the cowboys get a break but don t bend washington defense that allowed just 10 first downs but also big play after big play to the eagles four plays of at least 30 yards the dam will break eventually for big d and the cowboys will avoid their first 0 2 start in 16 years why bobby picked the 49ers it turns out that a team with 182 6 million in dead cap two rookie wide receivers starting and a dearth of experience in the secondary is going to take some time to figure things out who knew apparently everyone involved in nfl com s game picks except me the dolphins were unable to keep up in their week 1 game against the raiders and the task to do so in week 2 will be far more difficult against a 49ers squad that embarrassed the rams down under miami is thoroughly outmatched by san francisco on a position by position basis considering kirk cousins was able to toss three touchdown passes against the fins while operating almost exclusively through short area throws brock purdy at this point a far more dynamic passer could have a huge day he showed great early chemistry with mike evans picked right back up with deebo samuel and should benefit from george kittle having a game under his belt post achilles injury christian mccaffrey looks to have a little bit more pep in his step running for 6 8 yards per carry in the season opener despite dealing with cramps plus nick bosa s return and the fred warner dre greenlaw reunion has already had a noticeable effect on san francisco s defense which isn t good news for malik willis in what will still only be his eighth career start this one is likely to be all 49ers why dan picked the chiefs the vibes could not be more different for these teams coming out of week 1 the chiefs demolished the division rival broncos making it clear patrick mahomes return from injury is not a nostalgia act then there are the colts who were smacked around at home by the ravens 41 23 i know it s early in the season but it s already starting to feel like desperate times for shane steichen s team indianapolis has lost eight consecutive games dating back to week 12 of last season the longest active losing streak in the nfl lou anarumo s defense was gashed for 202 rushing yards and four rushing tds by baltimore i m not sure a week is enough time for him to find a way to slow down a suddenly super charged kansas city ground game led by marquee offseason addition kenneth walker now the colts have a strong rushing attack of their own jonathan taylor ran for nearly 100 yards and two tds last week but it wasn t nearly enough the chiefs appear to be the much better equipped squad when it comes to keeping the opposition s strength in check monday sept 21 why bobby picked the rams what a difference a week makes the rams were rolling into the season as super bowl favorites thanks to one of the splashiest offseasons in recent memory having rebuilt their secondary traded for reigning defensive player of the year myles garrett and enticed the great aaron donald out of retirement then came their season opener against the rival 49ers in australia an utterly catastrophic debut for los angeles super team to make matters worse garrett subsequently underwent knee surgery and is now on injured reserve without a timeline to return the question is whether the rams can pick up the pieces against the giants it s a task that appears a bit more difficult than initially expected both because sean mcvay s club has a ton to correct and because big blue was one of the surprises of week 1 scoring a decisive victory over the cowboys to begin the john harbaugh era new york s sunday night destruction of dallas continued jaxson dart s trend of showing up in prime time he boasts the highest passer rating 114 5 of any quarterback with at least three prime time starts per nfl research all of that leads me to believe the giants will make it close rather than win though i trust matthew stafford to rebound and los angeles has enough stars to survive garrett s absence this is also a sneaky important game for the rams they cannot afford to fall to 0 2 with their next three games coming against the broncos eagles and bills thursday s game why gennaro picked the bills there will be points i know that because the good folks at nfl research tell me detroit 29 7 ppg and buffalo 28 8 ppg boast the two highest scoring offenses in the league over everyone s past 50 regular season games furthermore it doesn t take a doctorate in statistics to see that these two defenses have issues the lions are highly suspect in the back end while the bills remain questionable up front so yes expect buffalo qb josh allen and detroit rb jahmyr gibbs to fill the fantasy coffers once again the last time these two teams met in december of 2024 they racked up 1 080 yards of offense in a scorefest the bills took 48 42 buffalo actually led that entire game though with detroit falling beyond by multiple touchdowns in each quarter before continually closing the gap to some degree i anticipate a similar game script on thursday night dan campbell s crew might aim to slow down the pace by pounding the rock but the lions are now down three starters on the offensive line add in the fact that the bills are christening their new 2 2 billion stadium and i ll ride with the home team visit responsibleplay org to learn more about responsible betting
